examples.text: Exactement, sauf pour ces bonnes profiteroles!
examples.trans: Exactly, except for these delicious profiteroles!

meanings.note: Un regard profond. Descriptive French adjective meaning 'deep'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.
Une réflexion profonde. Descriptive French adjective meaning 'deep'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: C'est un scénario profond et intelligent.
examples.trans: It is a profound and intelligent screenplay.

examples.text: Un silence profond.
examples.trans: A deep silence.

examples.text: Quelque chose de plus profond, qui nous rapprocherait un jour.
examples.trans: Something deeper, that would bring us closer one day.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la profondeur', plural 'les profondeurs') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'depth'.

examples.text: Accéder aux profondeurs.
examples.trans: To access the depths.

examples.text: La profondeur des sentiments.
examples.trans: The depth of feelings.

examples.text: Ce qui compte vraiment, ce sont les profondeurs.
examples.trans: What really matters is the depths.

meanings.note: Manner adverb formed by adding '-ment' (from Latin 'mente', 'with a ... mind') to the feminine adjective stem.

examples.text: Respirez profondément pendant le yoga.
examples.trans: Breathe deeply during yoga.

examples.text: Respirez profondément, tout va bien.
examples.trans: Breathe deeply, all is well.

examples.text: Je suis profondément soulagé de t'entendre.
examples.trans: I am deeply relieved to hear you.

meanings.note: un changement de programme = a change of plans/schedule

examples.text: Nous avons un léger changement de programme.
examples.trans: We have a slight change of schedule.

examples.text: Quel est le programme?
examples.trans: What is the schedule?

examples.text: J'ai besoin de son programme.
examples.trans: I need his schedule.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la progression', plural 'les progressions') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'progression'.

examples.text: Il faut une progression dans la scène.
examples.trans: There must be a progression in the scene.

examples.text: La progression du récit est captivante.
examples.trans: The progression of the narrative is captivating.

meanings.note: Manner adverb formed by adding '-ment' (from Latin 'mente', 'with a ... mind') to the feminine adjective stem.

examples.text: La situation s'améliore progressivement.
examples.trans: The situation improves gradually.

examples.text: Mais je compte la décourager progressivement...
examples.trans: But I plan to discourage her gradually...

meanings.note: faire des progrès = to make progress

examples.text: Promouvoir le progrès!
examples.trans: Promote progress!

examples.text: Le progrès scientifique.
examples.trans: Scientific progress.

examples.text: Quel progrès! Aujourd'hui notre cour accueille des retrouvailles: discrétion absolue!
examples.trans: What progress! Today our courtyard hosts a reunion: complete discretion!

meanings.note: A film screening, the showing of a film on a screen.

examples.text: La projection commence à huit heures.
examples.trans: The screening starts at eight.

examples.text: Je viens d'une projection.
examples.trans: I've come from a screening.

examples.text: Andréa. Je viens d'assister à une projection.
examples.trans: Andréa. I've just been to a screening.

meanings.note: A film, a plan.

examples.text: C'est un beau projet.
examples.trans: It's a lovely project.

examples.text: Tu as des projets ce soir?
examples.trans: Do you have plans tonight?

meanings.en: to extend (a stay, reservation, or visit)
meanings.note: Takes -ge- before a/o: nous prolongeons. Prolonger son séjour = extend one's stay.

examples.text: Elle souhaite prolonger son séjour de deux semaines.
examples.trans: She would like to extend her stay by two weeks.

examples.text: Le beau temps prolonge la soirée sous les lanternes.
examples.trans: The lovely weather extends the evening under the lanterns.

meanings.note: Leisurely walk or tree-lined walkway ('faire une promenade' = go for a stroll).

examples.text: Une petite promenade après le déjeuner fait toujours du bien.
examples.trans: A short stroll after lunch always feels good.

examples.text: La promenade ombragée longe la rivière jusqu'au pont.
examples.trans: The shaded walkway follows the river down to the bridge.

promener.gloss: to walk (a dog), to take for a walk

meanings.note: promener son chien = walk one's dog; se promener = go for a walk

examples.text: Je promène mon chien.
examples.trans: I'm walking my dog.

examples.text: On se promenait dans le quartier.
examples.trans: We were taking a walk in the neighborhood.

meanings.note: Solemn pledge or commitment ('tenir sa promesse' = keep one's promise).

examples.text: Trente ans plus tard, ils ont tenu leur promesse.
examples.trans: Thirty years later, they kept their promise.

examples.text: Cette lettre se termine par une belle promesse d'amitié.
examples.trans: This letter ends with a lovely promise of friendship.

meanings.note: Derived with the Romance agent/quality suffix '-eur'/'-euse' (from Latin '-or'/'-tor').

examples.text: C'est un début de carrière très prometteur.
examples.trans: It is a very promising career debut.

examples.text: C'est un début très prometteur.
examples.trans: It is a very promising beginning.

examples.text: Tu es un petit agent prometteur?
examples.trans: You are a promising junior agent?

examples.text: Je ne promets rien.
examples.trans: I'm not promising anything.

examples.text: Tu promets?
examples.trans: Do you promise?

meanings.note: used as an interjection or adjective

examples.text: Je ne dis rien, promis.
examples.trans: I say nothing, promised.

examples.text: C'est promis.
examples.trans: It is promised.

examples.text: Promis, nous prendrons un café.
examples.trans: Promised, we will have a coffee.

meanings.note: faire la promotion = to do publicity
Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Standard feminine noun meaning 'promotion, publicity'.

examples.text: L'actrice fait la promotion de son nouveau film.
examples.trans: The actress is promoting her new film.

examples.text: Toute l'agence prépare la promotion du spectacle.
examples.trans: The whole agency is preparing the promotion of the show.

examples.text: Sans promotion, le film va être un échec.
examples.trans: Without promotion, the movie will be a flop.

meanings.note: Irregular verb like émouvoir. French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire'). Core French verb meaning 'to promote'.

examples.text: Tu pourrais promouvoir la paix.
examples.trans: You could promote peace.

examples.text: Promouvoir un film.
examples.trans: To promote a movie.

examples.text: Tu pourrais promouvoir la paix et le progrès!
examples.trans: You could promote peace and progress!

meanings.note: Prononcer un nom = to utter a name. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to pronounce'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'prononcé').

examples.text: Ne prononcez pas ce nom.
examples.trans: Do not pronounce that name.

examples.text: Prononcer un discours.
examples.trans: To deliver a speech.

examples.text: Ne prononcez plus ce nom ici!
examples.trans: Do not utter that name here anymore!

meanings.note: Poetic prediction or foretelling that comes true years later.

examples.text: Sa petite phrase écrite jadis résonne comme une prophétie.
examples.trans: Her little line written long ago rings out like a prophecy.

examples.text: Dans les contes, chaque énigme cache une vieille prophétie.
examples.trans: In tales, every riddle hides an old prophecy.

meanings.note: Often plural for architectural balance.

examples.text: Oh... regardez les proportions de cette charpente en bois!
examples.trans: Oh... look at the proportions of this timber frame!

examples.text: Voici la proportion sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the proportion, scale on the table.

meanings.note: à propos de = regarding, about; à ce propos = speaking of which

examples.text: J'ai entendu crier à propos de beurre depuis le fond de la cour.
examples.trans: I heard shouting about butter from the back of the courtyard.

examples.text: À propos, tu viens?
examples.trans: By the way, are you coming?

meanings.note: Proposer un rôle à quelqu'un.
Proposer un rôle à quelqu'un.

examples.text: Je vous propose un thé à la menthe?
examples.trans: May I offer you a mint tea?

examples.text: Elle propose une idée pour sauver l'hôtel.
examples.trans: She suggests an idea to save the hotel.

meanings.note: Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Standard feminine noun meaning 'proposal, offer'.

examples.text: Vérifier cette proposition.
examples.trans: To check this proposal.

examples.text: Une proposition intéressante.
examples.trans: An interesting offer.

examples.text: Je vais l'appeler pour vérifier cette proposition.
examples.trans: I will call him to check this proposal.

meanings.note: Son propre salon = her own salon.
Une chambre propre = a clean room.

examples.text: Elle a son propre salon.
examples.trans: She has her own salon.

examples.text: La maison est très propre.
examples.trans: The house is very clean.

examples.text: Bonsoir. Pardon pour l'eau sur votre sol propre.
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for the water on your clean floor.

meanings.note: In a tidy, neat, and orderly manner.
Formed from the adjective propre ('clean, neat') + adverbial suffix -ment.

examples.text: Et les deux sacs à dos verts sont posés proprement sur le banc à côté de la chambre deux.
examples.trans: And both green backpacks are set neatly on the bench beside Room Two.

examples.text: Elle a plié les serviettes blanches très proprement sur le plateau.
examples.trans: She folded the white napkins very neatly on the tray.

meanings.note: le propriétaire de l'agence = the owner of the agency

examples.text: C'est le nouveau propriétaire de l'agence.
examples.trans: He is the new owner of the agency.

examples.text: Changer de propriétaire.
examples.trans: To change owners.

examples.text: Son propriétaire va sûrement le chercher bientôt.
examples.trans: Its owner will surely look for it soon.

meanings.note: La propriété intellectuelle. Feminine noun ('la propriété', plural 'les propriétés') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'property'.

examples.text: Spécialisée en propriété intellectuelle.
examples.trans: Specialized in intellectual property.

examples.text: Une belle propriété.
examples.trans: A beautiful property.

examples.text: Droit, spécialisée en propriété intellectuelle.
examples.trans: Law school, specialized in intellectual property.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to propel'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'propulsé').

examples.text: Elle a été propulsée.
examples.trans: She was fast-tracked.

examples.text: Propulser une carrière.
examples.trans: To propel a career.

examples.text: Certains disent que tu as été propulsée.
examples.trans: Some people say that you were fast-tracked.

meanings.note: Derived with the Romance agent/quality suffix '-eur'/'-euse' (from Latin '-or'/'-tor').

examples.text: C'est mon rôle d'agent protecteur.
examples.trans: It is my role as a protective agent.

examples.text: Elle a une attitude très protectrice.
examples.trans: She has a very protective attitude.

meanings.note: La protection du patrimoine refers to official historic-building preservation status.

examples.text: Ce vieux bâtiment bénéficie de la protection du patrimoine.
examples.trans: This old building enjoys heritage preservation status.

examples.text: Henri porte des gants épais pour sa protection.
examples.trans: Henri wears thick gloves for protection.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le protocole', plural 'les protocoles') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'protocol'.

examples.text: Discuter sans protocole.
examples.trans: To chat without protocol.

examples.text: Oui, pour discuter sans protocole ni caméras.
examples.trans: Oui, to chat without protocol or cameras.

meanings.note: protéger quelqu'un de quelque chose

examples.text: Alors le bail de votre hôtel est protégé pour dix ans par la ville!
examples.trans: Then your hotel lease is protected for ten years by the city!

examples.text: Il protège sa famille.
examples.trans: He protects his family.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to prove'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'prouvé').

examples.text: Ils essaient de prouver leur thèse.
examples.trans: They try to prove their thesis.

examples.text: Qu'est-ce que l'agence UBA essaie de prouver?
examples.trans: What is agency UBA trying to prove?

examples.text: Nous allons prouver notre grande force.
examples.trans: We are going to prove our great strength.

meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to come from'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: Ce bruit bizarre semble provenir du couloir.
examples.trans: That strange noise seems to come from the hallway.

examples.text: Ces fleurs proviennent du marché du quartier.
examples.trans: These flowers come from the neighbourhood market.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to provoke'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'provoqué').

examples.text: Tu cherches à me provoquer?
examples.trans: Are you trying to provoke me?

examples.text: Cela peut provoquer des ennuis.
examples.trans: That can cause trouble.

examples.text: C'était une erreur, il m'a provoquée.
examples.trans: It was a mistake, he provoked me.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'cautious'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Nous allons être très prudents.
examples.trans: We are going to be very careful.

examples.text: Merci docteur, nous allons être très prudents.
examples.trans: Thank you doctor, we are going to be very careful.

examples.text: Sois très prudent avec ce tournage.
examples.trans: Be very careful with this filming.

meanings.note: Près de = near.

examples.text: Il y a vingt-cinq ans, je donnais des cours de piano près d'ici.
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago, I taught piano lessons near here.

examples.text: Dix, onze, douze. Le compte est bon au centime près, merci!
examples.trans: Ten, eleven, twelve. Exact to the last cent, thank you!

examples.text: À droite, près du bureau, là où la lumière est bonne.
examples.trans: On the right, near the desk, where the light is good.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la précaution', plural 'les précautions') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'precaution'.

examples.text: C'est juste une précaution.
examples.trans: It is just a precaution.

examples.text: Pas du tout, c'est juste une précaution.
examples.trans: Not at all, it is just a precaution.

meanings.note: Un rôle précieux = a precious role. French relational/descriptive adjective derived from Latin adjectival roots. Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'.

examples.text: Ces rôles sont précieux.
examples.trans: These roles are precious.

examples.text: Un précieux conseil.
examples.trans: A valuable piece of advice.

examples.text: Merci, Henri. Ce petit train en bois à l'intérieur avait l'air ancien et précieux.
examples.trans: Thank you, Henri. That little wooden train inside looked old and precious.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le précipice', plural 'les précipices') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'precipice'.

examples.text: Au bord du précipice.
examples.trans: On the edge of the precipice.

examples.text: La voiture s'est arrêtée devant le précipice.
examples.trans: The car stopped before the cliff.

examples.text: Nous étions vraiment au bord du précipice.
examples.trans: We were truly on the edge of the cliff.

meanings.en: to rush, to hasten; se précipiter = to rush into, to flock
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to rush'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'précipité').

examples.text: Ne te précipite pas.
examples.trans: Do not rush.

examples.text: Tout le monde se précipite.
examples.trans: Everyone is rushing in.

examples.text: Personne ne se précipite dans ton bureau?
examples.trans: Nobody is rushing to your office?

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'precise'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Il donne des ordres précis au garde.
examples.trans: He gives precise orders to the guard.

examples.text: Pourquoi il y a des dessins précis de trois hôtels de notre rue?
examples.trans: Why are there neat drawings of three hotels on our street?

meanings.note: Manner adverb formed by adding '-ment' (from Latin 'mente', 'with a ... mind') to the feminine adjective stem. Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'.

examples.text: Ils arrivent précisément à l'heure convenue.
examples.trans: They arrive precisely at the agreed time.

examples.text: Ils arrivent précisément à vingt-deux heures.
examples.trans: They arrive precisely at ten PM.

meanings.note: Feminine: prédatrice. Derived with the Romance agent/quality suffix '-eur'/'-euse' (from Latin '-or'/'-tor'). Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'. Standard masculine noun meaning 'predator'.

examples.text: Céder à un prédateur.
examples.trans: To yield to a predator.

examples.text: Un comportement de prédateur.
examples.trans: Predatory behavior.

examples.text: Je ne vais pas céder à un prédateur.
examples.trans: I am not going to yield to a predator.

meanings.note: je préfère = I prefer; tu préférerais = would you rather

examples.text: Je préfère le café.
examples.trans: I prefer coffee.

examples.text: Tu préférerais rester?
examples.trans: Would you rather stay?

meanings.note: also used as a noun: mon préféré = my favourite (one)

examples.text: Mon préféré, Pierre Niney.
examples.trans: My favourite, Pierre Niney.

examples.text: C'est mon film préféré.
examples.trans: It's my favourite film.

meanings.note: Tout était prémédité. Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'.

examples.text: Tout était prémédité.
examples.trans: It was all premeditated.

examples.text: Une action préméditée.
examples.trans: A premeditated action.

examples.text: Maintenant tout s'explique! Tout était prémédité.
examples.trans: Now it all makes sense! It was all premeditated.

meanings.note: choisir un prénom = to choose a first name

examples.text: Quel est ton prénom?
examples.trans: What is your first name?

examples.text: Une liste de prénoms.
examples.trans: A list of first names.

examples.text: Regarde sous les roues: ton prénom et le mien sont toujours écrits au crayon.
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels: your first name and mine are still written in pencil.

meanings.en: to worry, to preoccupy, to trouble
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to worry'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'préoccupé').

examples.text: Ce problème me préoccupe.
examples.trans: This problem worries me.

examples.text: Ne vous préoccupez pas.
examples.trans: Do not worry.

examples.text: Ce n'est pas le passé qui me préoccupe.
examples.trans: It is not the past that worries me.

meanings.note: From préparer ('to prepare').

examples.text: La préparation de la pâte demande des gestes réguliers.
examples.trans: Preparing the dough calls for steady movements.

examples.text: Toute l'équipe aide à la préparation du thé du vendredi.
examples.trans: The whole team helps prepare Friday tea.

examples.text: Il prépare le dîner.
examples.trans: He's making dinner.

examples.text: Nadia l'a préparé ce matin quand Madame Odette lui a raconté nos vendredis.
examples.trans: Nadia baked it this morning when Madam Odette told her about our Fridays.

meanings.note: La présence de quelqu'un. Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'. Standard feminine noun meaning 'presence, attendance'.
Avoir de la présence. Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'. Standard feminine noun meaning 'presence, attendance'.

examples.text: Salut Andréa, laisse-moi t'expliquer ma présence...
examples.trans: Hi Andrea, let me explain my presence...

examples.text: Nous apprécions beaucoup votre présence.
examples.trans: We appreciate your presence very much.

examples.text: Elle a besoin de notre présence.
examples.trans: She needs our presence.

meanings.note: Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'.

examples.text: Il sera moins présent au bureau.
examples.trans: He will be less present at the office.

examples.text: Il sera moins présent chez ASK.
examples.trans: He will be less present at ASK.

examples.text: NOW signifie maintenant, c'est le présent immédiat!
examples.trans: NOW means right now, it is the immediate present!

meanings.note: Usually plural: les présentations. Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'. Standard feminine noun meaning 'introduction; presentation'.
Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'. Standard feminine noun meaning 'introduction; presentation'.

examples.text: Pas besoin de présentations.
examples.trans: No need for introductions.

examples.text: Je fais les présentations.
examples.trans: I'll do the introductions.

examples.text: C'est maintenant la saison des présentations d'atelier.
examples.trans: It is now theater workshop showcase season.

meanings.note: Je vous présente Camille.
présenter ses excuses = to apologise (formal)

examples.text: Je vous présente Andréa.
examples.trans: Let me introduce Andréa.

examples.text: Je vous présente mes excuses.
examples.trans: I apologise.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to presume'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'présumé').

examples.text: Annick, je présume?
examples.trans: Annick, I presume?

examples.text: Je présume que oui.
examples.trans: I presume so.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le prétendant', plural 'les prétendants') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'suitor'.

examples.text: Elle a beaucoup de prétendants.
examples.trans: She has many suitors.

examples.text: Tu intimides peut-être beaucoup de prétendants.
examples.trans: You perhaps intimidate many suitors.

meanings.note: Prétendre que. Third-group irregular verb inherited from core Latin roots ('-ere'). Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'. Core French verb meaning 'to claim, assert'.
Prétendre à un poste. Third-group irregular verb inherited from core Latin roots ('-ere'). Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'. Core French verb meaning 'to claim, assert'.

examples.text: Élisabeth prétend qu'il y a un scandale.
examples.trans: Elisabeth claims that there is a scandal.

examples.text: Il prétend connaître la vérité.
examples.trans: He claims to know the truth.

examples.text: Oui, il sait tout et prétend être le père.
examples.trans: Yes, he knows everything and claims to be the father.

meanings.note: sous prétexte de = under the pretext of

examples.text: Derrière ce prétexte.
examples.trans: Behind this pretext.

examples.text: Trouver un prétexte.
examples.trans: To find a pretext.

examples.text: Arrête de te cacher derrière ce prétexte!
examples.trans: Stop hiding behind this pretext!

meanings.note: Prefix 'pré-' (from Latin 'prae-') means 'before, in advance'.

examples.text: Vous êtes toujours très prévenante.
examples.trans: You are always very thoughtful.

examples.text: Un geste prévenant et délicat.
examples.trans: A thoughtful and delicate gesture.

examples.text: Merci Camille, vous êtes toujours très prévenante.
examples.trans: Thank you Camille, you are always very thoughtful.

meanings.en: to warn, to inform in advance
meanings.note: conjugated like 'venir', but with 'avoir'

examples.text: Pourquoi tu ne m'as pas prévenue?
examples.trans: Why didn't you warn me?

examples.text: Je te préviens demain.
examples.trans: I'll let you know tomorrow.

meanings.en: to plan, to anticipate, to foresee
meanings.note: Comme prévu = as planned.

examples.text: Je suis là, comme prévu.
examples.trans: I am here, as planned.

examples.text: Nous prévoyons un voyage.
examples.trans: We are planning a trip.

examples.text: Je rêve ou quoi?! Tu avais prévu toutes ces retrouvailles, Antoine?
examples.trans: Am I dreaming or what?! Did you plan this whole reunion, Antoine?

meanings.note: Prêt à + infinitive = ready to.

examples.text: Tu es prête?
examples.trans: Are you ready?

examples.text: Ils sont prêts à partir.
examples.trans: They're ready to leave.

meanings.note: Prêter quelque chose à quelqu'un.

examples.text: Il nous prête de l'argent.
examples.trans: He lends us money.

examples.text: Tu peux me prêter ce livre?
examples.trans: Can you lend me that book?

meanings.en: psychiatrist, medical doctor specializing in mental health
meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le psychiatre', plural 'les psychiatres') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'psychiatrist'.

examples.text: Consulter un psychiatre.
examples.trans: To consult a psychiatrist.

examples.text: Un bon psychiatre.
examples.trans: A good psychiatrist.

examples.text: Arrêtez de parler comme des psychiatres!
examples.trans: Stop talking like psychiatrists!

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la pub', plural 'les pubs') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'ad'.

examples.text: Je voudrais te montrer des photos pour une pub.
examples.trans: I would like to show you photos for an ad.

examples.text: Cette pub passe tout le temps à la télé.
examples.trans: This ad is on TV all the time.

meanings.note: Ouvert au public means 'open to the public'. (As an adjective, masculine public becomes publique in the feminine.)

examples.text: Le jardin de l'hôtel sera ouvert au public le vendredi.
examples.trans: The hotel garden will be open to the public on Fridays.

examples.text: Un nombreux public est venu écouter le concert du soir.
examples.trans: A large audience came to listen to the evening concert.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'advertising'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Un contrat publicitaire important.
examples.trans: An important advertising contract.

examples.text: C'est pour son contrat publicitaire avec Cartier.
examples.trans: It is for her advertising contract with Cartier.

examples.text: J'ai réfléchi pour les contrats publicitaires.
examples.trans: I thought about the advertising contracts.

meanings.note: une agence de publicité = an advertising agency

examples.text: J'ai déjà un agent pour la publicité.
examples.trans: I already have an agent for advertising.

examples.text: Faire de la publicité.
examples.trans: To advertise.

examples.text: La publicité, ce n'est pas le cinéma.
examples.trans: Advertising is not cinema.

meanings.en: to publish, to print, to release
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to print'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'publié').

examples.text: Ils ne doivent pas publier!
examples.trans: They must not publish!

examples.text: Appelle les magazines, ils ne doivent pas publier!
examples.trans: Call the magazines, they must not publish!

meanings.en: flea; microchip; term of endearment (petite puce)
meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la puce', plural 'les puces') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'flea'.

examples.text: Ma petite puce.
examples.trans: My little sweetie.

examples.text: Une puce électronique.
examples.trans: An electronic chip.

examples.text: C'est Hicham pour la petite puce.
examples.trans: It is Hicham for the little flea.

meanings.note: Connects actions in sequence.

examples.text: Il travaille, puis il rentre.
examples.trans: He works, then he goes home.

examples.text: Non, soulevez d'abord la poignée, puis poussez.
examples.trans: No, lift the handle first, then push.

meanings.note: Toute la puissance = all the power.

examples.text: Toute la puissance d'un lion!
examples.trans: All the power of a lion!

examples.text: La puissance du moteur.
examples.trans: The power of the engine.

meanings.note: Strong or powerful in effect; feminine puissante pronounces the t.

examples.text: Le rôle est puissant.
examples.trans: The part is powerful.

examples.text: Une voiture puissante.
examples.trans: A powerful car.

examples.text: Parce que le rôle est puissant, plein de vie!
examples.trans: Because the part is powerful, full of life!

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le pull', plural 'les pulls') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'sweater'.

examples.text: Mets un pull chaud, il fait frais ce soir.
examples.trans: Put on a warm jumper, it is chilly tonight.

examples.text: J'adore ton nouveau pull en laine bleue.
examples.trans: I love your new blue wool sweater.

pupitre.gloss: music stand, music rack (on a piano); desk

meanings.en: music rack (of a piano), music stand, lectern
meanings.note: On an upright or grand piano, le pupitre is the hinged wooden rest that holds sheet music.

examples.text: Odette pose la partition ouverte sur le pupitre du piano.
examples.trans: Odette places the open sheet music on the piano's music rack.

examples.text: Une feuille pliée s'était glissée derrière le pupitre.
examples.trans: A folded sheet had slipped behind the music rack.

examples.text: De l'eau pure.
examples.trans: Pure water.

examples.text: Pur hasard, plus une valise bleue échangée dans le train de lundi matin!
examples.trans: Pure luck, plus one swapped blue suitcase on Monday morning's train!

meanings.note: From 'pur' (pure) + -ment (-ly).

examples.text: C'est purement professionnel.
examples.trans: It's purely professional.

examples.text: C'est purement amical.
examples.trans: It's strictly friendly.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la putréfaction', plural 'les putréfactions') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'putrefaction'.

examples.text: Une odeur de putréfaction.
examples.trans: A smell of putrefaction.

examples.text: En état de putréfaction.
examples.trans: In a state of decay.

examples.text: Non, c'est plutôt une odeur de putréfaction.
examples.trans: No, it is rather a smell of putrefaction.

meanings.en: mentor, sculptor of talent, Pygmalion figure
meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le pygmalion', plural 'les pygmalions') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'mentor'.

examples.text: Elle sera son pygmalion.
examples.trans: She will be his Pygmalion.

examples.text: Je serai son propre pygmalion.
examples.trans: I will be his own Pygmalion.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le pyjama', plural 'les pyjamas') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'nightwear'.

examples.text: J'ai apporté un pyjama.
examples.trans: I brought pyjamas.

examples.text: J'ai juste un pyjama et des mouchoirs. Merci!
examples.trans: I just have pajamas and tissues. Thank you!

examples.text: Vous quittez votre pyjama pour votre costume.
examples.trans: You take off your pajamas for your suit.

meanings.note: Avoir l'air pâle = to look pale. Descriptive French adjective meaning 'pale'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Étienne! Vous êtes tout pâle! Asseyez-vous: qu'est-ce que dit la lettre?
examples.trans: Etienne! You went completely pale! Sit down: what does the letter say?

examples.text: Vous avez l'air pâle.
examples.trans: You look pale.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la pâleur', plural 'les pâleurs') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'pallor'.

examples.text: Cette pâleur spectrale est vraiment magnifique.
examples.trans: This spectral pallor is really magnificent.

examples.text: La pâleur de son visage inquiet.
examples.trans: The paleness of his worried face.

examples.text: Cette pâleur spectrale me semble étrange.
examples.trans: That ghostly pallor seems strange to me.

meanings.note: For ink, paint, or fabric to fade over time; for someone to turn pale.

examples.text: À l'abri de la lumière, l'encre n'a presque pas pâli.
examples.trans: Sheltered from the light, the ink has barely faded.

examples.text: Les rideaux exposés au soleil finissent par pâlir.
examples.trans: Curtains exposed to the sun eventually fade.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la pâte', plural 'les pâtes') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'dough'.
Feminine noun ('la pâte', plural 'les pâtes') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'pasta'.

examples.text: Préparer une bonne pâte à pain.
examples.trans: To prepare good bread dough.

examples.text: Mon pain est déjà dans le four, au moins.
examples.trans: My bread is already in the oven, at least.

meanings.note: To make tarts, brioches, cakes, and sweet pastries.

examples.text: Le dimanche après-midi, toute la maison aime pâtisser.
examples.trans: On Sunday afternoons, the whole household loves baking.

examples.text: Elle écoute toujours de la musique douce quand elle pâtisse.
examples.trans: She always listens to soft music when she bakes.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la pâtisserie', plural 'les pâtisseries') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'pastry'.
Feminine noun ('la pâtisserie', plural 'les pâtisseries') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'pastry shop'.

examples.text: Nous achetons des gâteaux à la pâtisserie.
examples.trans: We buy cakes at the pastry shop.

examples.text: Non, avec les meilleures pâtisseries parisiennes!
examples.trans: No, with the best Parisian pastries!

meanings.note: Savory baked terrine or pastry pie; 'un pâté de maisons' = a city block; ink blot.

examples.text: La librairie se trouve à deux pâtés de maisons d'ici.
examples.trans: The bookshop is two blocks away from here.

examples.text: Nous avons fait le tour du pâté de maisons en cinq minutes.
examples.trans: We walked around the block in five minutes.

examples.text: Mon père, mais c'est compliqué.
examples.trans: My dad, but it's complicated.

examples.text: Son père est agent.
examples.trans: Her father is an agent.

meanings.note: On a piano, the right sustain *pédale* lifts the dampers so notes ring warmly together.

examples.text: Les deux pédales en laiton du piano brillent comme de l'or.
examples.trans: The piano's two brass pedals shine like gold.

examples.text: Appuyez doucement sur la pédale de droite à la fin de l'accord.
examples.trans: Press gently on the right pedal at the end of the chord.

related.gloss: key (of a piano or keyboard), button

meanings.note: pédaler comme une folle = to pedal like crazy

examples.text: Je pédale comme une folle!
examples.trans: I pedal like crazy!

examples.text: Il pédale vite.
examples.trans: He pedals fast.

examples.text: Il gèle à vélo. Je pédale comme une folle!
examples.trans: It's freezing on a bike. I pedal like crazy!

meanings.note: Of a person, informal.
Of a task.

examples.text: Tu es pénible!
examples.trans: You're a pain!

examples.text: C'est un travail pénible.
examples.trans: It's tiring work.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le péril', plural 'les périls') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'peril'.

examples.text: Mettre en péril la relation.
examples.trans: Jeopardizing the relationship.

examples.text: Mettre en péril une relation de confiance?
examples.trans: Jeopardizing a relationship of trust?

meanings.note: De l'eau pétillante.
De l'eau pétillante.

examples.text: Il est bon, ce pétillant.
examples.trans: It's good, this bubbly.

examples.text: Tu veux un verre de pétillant?
examples.trans: Do you want a glass of bubbly?

examples.text: Il est bon, ce pétillant. Un peu jeune.
examples.trans: It's good, this bubbly. A bit young.

meanings.note: Regular *-ir* verb (*je pétris, nous pétrissons, j'ai pétri*).

examples.text: Il pétrit la pâte à pain dix minutes sur la table farinée.
examples.trans: He kneads the bread dough for ten minutes on the floured table.

examples.text: Plus on pétrit la pâte avec soin, plus le pain lève bien.
examples.trans: The more carefully you knead the dough, the better the bread rises.

meanings.note: business term for a specialized branch

examples.text: Un pôle auteurs-réalisateurs.
examples.trans: A writer-directors department.

examples.text: Tu sais ce que j'aimerais? Un pôle auteurs-réalisateurs.
examples.trans: Do you know what I'd like? A writers-directors department.

meanings.note: Followed by qui when what is the subject, or que when what is the object.

examples.text: Qu'est-ce qu'il dit? Pourquoi vous froncez les sourcils?
examples.trans: What is he saying? Why are you frowning?

examples.text: Sans mes notes, qu'est-ce que je dis quand il passe ce portail?
examples.trans: Without my notes, what do I say when he walks through that gate?

meanings.note: starts a question: qu'est-ce que tu fais? = what are you doing?

examples.text: Qu'est-ce que tu cherches dans le tiroir?
examples.trans: What are you looking for in the drawer?

examples.text: Qu'est-ce que c'est, ce bruit?
examples.trans: What's that noise?

meanings.note: question word when 'what' is the subject: qu'est-ce qui se passe? = what's happening?

examples.text: Qu'est-ce qui se passe ici?
examples.trans: What's going on here?

examples.text: Qu'est-ce qui est urgent?
examples.trans: What's urgent?

meanings.note: Sur le quai numéro deux = on platform two.

examples.text: De la soupe chaude? Après cette marche froide sous la pluie, ça a l'air merveilleux.
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: Dire que lundi matin, Antoine a pris la mauvaise valise bleue sur le quai numéro deux.
examples.trans: To think that Monday morning, Antoine picked up the wrong blue suitcase on platform two.

examples.text: Je n'ai aucune qualification, mais je peux apprendre.
examples.trans: I have no qualifications, but I can learn.

examples.text: Il a toutes les qualifications pour ce poste.
examples.trans: He has all the qualifications for this job.

meanings.note: Une grande qualité. Feminine abstract noun formed with '-ité' (from Latin '-itas', English '-ity'). Standard feminine noun meaning 'virtue, quality'.
Un service de qualité. Feminine abstract noun formed with '-ité' (from Latin '-itas', English '-ity'). Standard feminine noun meaning 'virtue, quality'.

examples.text: Et quelle est votre plus grande qualité?
examples.trans: And what is your greatest quality?

examples.text: La patience est une belle qualité.
examples.trans: Patience is a fine quality.

examples.text: Ce sont les qualités qu'il faut dans ce métier.
examples.trans: Those are the qualities you need in this business.

meanings.note: Question word or conjunction.

examples.text: Vous serez là quand?
examples.trans: When will you be here?

examples.text: Quand tu veux.
examples.trans: Whenever you like.

meanings.en: still, all the same, even so
meanings.note: c'est quand même une cliente = she's still a client
C'est quand même bizarre. Spoken French phrase expression meaning 'still', common in natural conversation.

examples.text: C'est quand même une cliente.
examples.trans: She's still a client.

examples.text: Merci quand même.
examples.trans: Thanks anyway.

examples.text: Mais c'est quand même une cliente.
examples.trans: But she's still a client.

meanings.note: Quarante et un = forty-one.

examples.text: Il a quarante ans.
examples.trans: He's forty.

examples.text: Elle a quarante et un ans.
examples.trans: She's forty-one.

meanings.note: Invariable French cardinal numeral meaning 'forty-five', used before plural nouns and in time/date expressions.

examples.text: Il a quarante-cinq ans dans le scénario.
examples.trans: He is forty-five years old in the script.

examples.text: Quarante-cinq minutes d'attente.
examples.trans: Forty-five minutes of waiting.

examples.text: Comment ça? Baptiste a quarante-cinq ans!
examples.trans: What do you mean? Baptiste is forty-five years old!

examples.text: Quarante-deux?
examples.trans: Forty-two?

examples.text: Elle a quarante-deux ans.
examples.trans: She's forty-two.

meanings.note: Compound number 40 + 4.

examples.text: Je ne chausse certainement pas du quarante-quatre!
examples.trans: I certainly do not wear size forty-four shoes!

examples.text: La chambre quarante-quatre n'existe pas ici!
examples.trans: Room forty-four doesn't exist here!

meanings.note: Et quart = quarter past the hour.

examples.text: Courez vite, Claire. La chambre quatre se réveille à sept heures et quart!
examples.trans: Run fast, Claire. Room four wakes up at quarter past seven!

examples.text: Voici le quart sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the quarter on the table.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le quartier', plural 'les quartiers') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'neighborhood'.

examples.text: comme un café du matin ouvert au quartier?!
examples.trans: like a morning cafe open to the neighbourhood?!

examples.text: Attendez, cette rue est juste ici dans notre quartier, à cinq minutes!
examples.trans: Wait, that street is right here in our neighbourhood, five minutes away!

examples.text: Assieds-toi, Claire! Tu as couru dans tout le quartier ce matin, bois un café.
examples.trans: Sit down, Claire! You ran all over the neighbourhood this morning, drink a coffee.

meanings.note: Quatorze heures = 2 pm.

examples.text: À quatorze heures.
examples.trans: At two in the afternoon.

examples.text: Quatorze ans.
examples.trans: Fourteen years old.

examples.text: À quatre heures du matin.
examples.trans: At four in the morning.

examples.text: J'ai quatre frères.
examples.trans: I have four brothers.

meanings.note: Invariable French cardinal numeral meaning 'ninety', used before plural nouns and in time/date expressions.

examples.text: Mon grand-père fête ses quatre-vingt-dix ans aujourd'hui.
examples.trans: My grandfather is celebrating his ninetieth birthday today.

examples.text: Le film dure environ quatre-vingt-dix minutes.
examples.trans: The film lasts about ninety minutes.

meanings.note: Eighty is four twenties; drops its s when another number follows, as in quatre-vingt-un.

examples.text: Une actrice de quatre-vingts ans.
examples.trans: An eighty-year-old actress.

examples.text: Quatre-vingts personnes, maximum.
examples.trans: Eighty people, tops.

examples.text: Du chêne massif, quatre-vingts ans d'âge.
examples.trans: Solid oak, eighty years old.

meanings.note: Ordinal number fourth (4e).

examples.text: Tournez à gauche après le quatrième réverbère.
examples.trans: Turn left past the fourth streetlamp.

examples.text: La quatrième fiche complète le dessin de la carte.
examples.trans: The fourth card completes the drawing of the map.

meanings.note: Joins two parts: dis-lui que.
Relative: tout ce que.
With ne: ne... que.
Ça fait trois semaines que.

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.
examples.trans: Tell her I can't come.

examples.text: Je n'ai que deux places.
examples.trans: I've only got two tickets.

meanings.note: Agrees with the noun.
Quelle surprise!.

examples.text: Quelle heure est-il? Neuf heures trente-cinq!
examples.trans: What time is it? Nine thirty-five!

examples.text: Quelle vitesse! L'épicier vous a donné un ticket?
examples.trans: What speed! Did the grocer give you a receipt?

meanings.note: Quelqu'un de jeune = someone young.

examples.text: Quelqu'un est là?
examples.trans: Is someone there?

examples.text: Il veut quelqu'un de jeune.
examples.trans: He wants someone young.

examples.text: Trouve quelque chose.
examples.trans: Think of something.

examples.text: Je veux quelque chose.
examples.trans: I want something.

examples.text: Trouve quelque chose.
examples.trans: Think of something.

examples.text: Tu veux quelque chose?
examples.trans: Do you want something?

examples.text: Je ne sais pas. Trouve quelque chose.
examples.trans: I don't know. Think of something.

question.gloss: question; matter (pas question = out of the question)

meanings.en: question; issue (pas question! = no way!, out of the question!)
meanings.note: Poser une question means 'to ask a question' (never demander une question). Pas question! is a crisp, idiomatic refusal meaning 'Not a chance! / Out of the question!'.

examples.text: Toucher aux fils sans couper le courant? Pas question!
examples.trans: Touching the wires without shutting off the power? Out of the question!

examples.text: Le client a posé une question sur l'histoire de la maison.
examples.trans: The guest asked a question about the history of the house.

examples.text: C'est un questionnaire pour la nounou.
examples.trans: This is a questionnaire for the nanny.

examples.text: Remplissez ce questionnaire.
examples.trans: Fill in this questionnaire.

examples.text: Attends une seconde. C'est un questionnaire pour la nounou.
examples.trans: Wait a second. This is a questionnaire for the nanny.

meanings.note: In qu'est-ce qui, the question expression supplies the subject, and need not refer to a person.

examples.text: Qui est là?
examples.trans: Who is there?

examples.text: Deux frères qui mangent du gâteau au citron?
examples.trans: Two brothers eating lemon cake?

meanings.en: savory pastry tart with eggs and cream
meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la quiche', plural 'les quiches') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'savory pastry tart with eggs and cream'.
Feminine noun ('la quiche', plural 'les quiches') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'incompetent'.

examples.text: Nous avons commandé une quiche chaude avec une salade.
examples.trans: We ordered a warm quiche with a salad.

examples.text: Elle prépare une délicieuse quiche pour le déjeuner.
examples.trans: She is making a delicious quiche for lunch.

meanings.note: Neighbourhood shop selling tools, screws, and valves.

examples.text: J'ai utilisé la dernière cet hiver. Seule la vieille quincaillerie après le pont vend cette taille.
examples.trans: I used the last one this winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge sells this size.

examples.text: À quelle heure ouvre cette quincaillerie?
examples.trans: What time does that hardware shop open?

examples.text: C'est fait. Maintenant, expliquez-moi comment trouver la quincaillerie.
examples.trans: Got it. Now explain to me how to find the hardware shop.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le quinoa', plural 'les quinoas') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'quinoa'.

examples.text: Du quinoa cuit.
examples.trans: Cooked quinoa.

examples.text: Une salade de quinoa.
examples.trans: A quinoa salad.

examples.text: Je mange une salade de quinoa.
examples.trans: I am eating a quinoa salad.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la quinzaine', plural 'les quinzaines') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'fortnight'.

examples.text: La Quinzaine des réalisateurs.
examples.trans: The Directors' Fortnight.

examples.text: Pendant une quinzaine.
examples.trans: For about two weeks.

examples.text: Non, il passe à la Quinzaine des réalisateurs.
examples.trans: No, it is screening at the Directors' Fortnight.

examples.text: Quinze ans.
examples.trans: Fifteen years.

examples.text: Il est quinze heures.
examples.trans: It's three p.m.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'even'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Nous sommes quittes.
examples.trans: We are even.

examples.text: Comme ça, on sera quittes enfin.
examples.trans: That way, we will be even finally.

examples.text: Oui, vous êtes quittes tous les deux!
examples.trans: Yes, you are both even now!

meanings.en: to leave someone, to break up with
meanings.note: Elle m'a quitté = she left me.
Always with an object.

examples.text: Il quitte l'agence.
examples.trans: He's leaving the agency.

examples.text: Ne me quitte pas.
examples.trans: Don't leave me.

meanings.note: informal, often at the end: pour faire quoi?, c'est quoi?

examples.text: Quoi, tu n'as pas encore lu le nouveau scénario?
examples.trans: What, you haven't read the new script yet?

examples.text: De quoi est-ce que vous parlez tous les deux?
examples.trans: What are the two of you talking about?

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'daily'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Vos nouveaux problèmes quotidiens.
examples.trans: Your new daily problems.

examples.text: La vie quotidienne à l'agence.
examples.trans: Daily life at the agency.

examples.text: Bonne chance avec vos nouveaux problèmes quotidiens!
examples.trans: Good luck with your new daily problems!

meanings.note: Folding flap of an envelope, pouch, pocket, or book dust jacket.

examples.text: Un message secret est caché sous le rabat de l'enveloppe.
examples.trans: A secret message is hidden under the flap of the envelope.

examples.text: Repliez bien le rabat en cuir pour fermer la sacoche.
examples.trans: Fold the leather flap down neatly to close the satchel.

examples.text: Quel rabat-joie!
examples.trans: What a killjoy!

examples.text: Ne fais pas le rabat-joie.
examples.trans: Don't be a spoilsport.

examples.text: Quel rabat-joie! On trinque?
examples.trans: What a killjoy! Shall we clink glasses?

meanings.note: Quicker path cutting between two streets ('prendre un raccourci').

examples.text: Cette ruelle étroite est le meilleur raccourci vers la place.
examples.trans: This narrow lane is the best shortcut to the square.

examples.text: Les habitants du quartier connaissent tous ce raccourci.
examples.trans: Everyone in the neighborhood knows this shortcut.

meanings.note: Opposite of décrocher. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to hang up'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'raccroché').
raccrocher les gants = to hang up the gloves

examples.text: Trop tard! Il a dit merci et il a raccroché!
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: Ne raccroche pas!
examples.trans: Do not hang up!

meanings.note: From racheter.

examples.text: Le rachat de l'agence.
examples.trans: The buyout of the agency.

examples.text: Le rachat est annulé.
examples.trans: The buyout is cancelled.

examples.text: Et l'agence? Le rachat de l'agence?
examples.trans: And the agency? The buyout of the agency?

meanings.en: to buy back, to buy out
meanings.note: Can mean acquire or buy out a business or shares, as well as buy something back.
Also buy more of something, such as bread.

examples.text: On peut racheter les parts.
examples.trans: We can buy the shares.

examples.text: Je rachète du pain.
examples.trans: I'm buying more bread.

examples.text: On peut racheter les parts de Samuel.
examples.trans: We can buy Samuel's shares.

meanings.note: faire ses racines = touch up one's roots
Les racines d'un arbre. Feminine noun ('la racine', plural 'les racines') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'root'.

examples.text: Je n'ai pas fait mes racines.
examples.trans: I have not done my roots.

examples.text: Les racines des cheveux poussent vite.
examples.trans: Hair roots grow fast.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la raclure', plural 'les raclures') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'scumbag'.

examples.text: Une espèce de raclure.
examples.trans: A real scumbag.

examples.text: Une vraie espèce de raclure.
examples.trans: A real kind of scumbag.

meanings.note: qu'est-ce que tu racontes? = what are you talking about?

examples.text: Raconte-moi une histoire.
examples.trans: Tell me a story.

examples.text: Le film raconte la vie de ma mère.
examples.trans: The film tells the story of my mother's life.

examples.text: Nadia l'a préparé ce matin quand Madame Odette lui a raconté nos vendredis.
examples.trans: Nadia baked it this morning when Madam Odette told her about our Fridays.

meanings.note: Hot-water room radiator.

examples.text: Touche le radiateur — le bas est chaud, alors que le haut devient froid.
examples.trans: Feel the radiator—the bottom is warm, while the top is turning cool.

examples.text: Voici le radiateur sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the radiator on the table.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la radio', plural 'les radios') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'radio'.

examples.text: Elle écoute l'émission à la radio.
examples.trans: She is listening to the broadcast on the radio.

examples.text: Elle est invitée en direct à la radio.
examples.trans: She is invited live on the radio.

examples.text: Elle m'attend en direct à la radio.
examples.trans: She is waiting for me live on the radio.

meanings.note: Inflexible. Descriptive French adjective meaning 'stiff'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Tu es raide!
examples.trans: You are stiff!

examples.text: Une jambe raide.
examples.trans: A stiff leg.

examples.text: Tu es raide, tu es comme un vieux beauf!
examples.trans: You are stiff, you are like an old redneck!

meanings.note: Avoir raison = to be right.
pour quelle raison? = for what reason?

examples.text: Tu as raison.
examples.trans: You're right.

examples.text: Il n'a pas raison.
examples.trans: He's not right.

meanings.note: Sois raisonnable = be reasonable. Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis').

examples.text: Il faut être raisonnables.
examples.trans: We must be sensible / reasonable.

examples.text: Un prix raisonnable.
examples.trans: A reasonable price.

examples.text: Il faut être raisonnables. Mathias va trouver une solution.
examples.trans: We must be reasonable. Mathias will find a solution.

meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to slow down'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: Tu devrais ralentir le rythme.
examples.trans: You should slow down the pace.

examples.text: Tu devrais vraiment ralentir le rythme.
examples.trans: You should really slow down the pace.

examples.text: Cette voiture passe sans ralentir.
examples.trans: This car passes without slowing down.

meanings.note: Built from re- + allumer.

examples.text: Pas une seule goutte! On peut rallumer la chaudière maintenant?
examples.trans: Not a single drop! Can we relight the boiler now?

examples.text: C'est facile à rallumer ensemble.
examples.trans: It is easy to relight, turn back on together.

meanings.note: Stem-changing *-er* verb (*e -> è* when the ending is silent: *je ramène, nous ramenons, je ramènerai*).

examples.text: Les dernières mesures nous ramènent doucement au thème du début.
examples.trans: The final bars gently lead us back to the opening theme.

examples.text: Je ramène les tasses vides à la cuisine après le thé.
examples.trans: I bring the empty cups back to the kitchen after tea.

related.gloss: to go home, to come back

meanings.note: Garder de la rancœur. Feminine noun ('la rancœur', plural 'les rancœurs') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'rancor'.

examples.text: La rancœur ne se contrôle pas.
examples.trans: Rancor cannot be controlled.

examples.text: Sans aucune rancœur.
examples.trans: Without any rancor.

examples.text: C'est quoi exactement? De la rancœur? Du ressentiment?
examples.trans: What is it exactly? Rancor? Resentment?

meanings.en: hike, ramble, long trek on foot
meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la randonnée', plural 'les randonnées') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'hike'.

examples.text: C'est comme faire une randonnée en tongs!
examples.trans: It is like hiking in flip-flops!

examples.text: Une belle randonnée en montagne le week-end.
examples.trans: A nice hike in the mountains on the weekend.

meanings.note: Au premier rang = in the front row.

examples.text: Attends vendredi à midi: je veux être au premier rang quand l'homme à la valise entrera!
examples.trans: Wait until Friday at noon: I want a front-row seat when Suitcase Man walks in!

examples.text: Voici le rang sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the row, rank on the table.

ranger.gloss: to put away, tidy up, store neatly

meanings.en: to put away, store, tidy up
meanings.note: Essential French household verb (with no single-word English twin) meaning both 'put something in its proper place' and 'tidy a room'. Keeps -ge- before a/o: nous rangeons.

examples.text: On plie les chaises et on les range au sec sous l'arche.
examples.trans: We fold the chairs and store them somewhere dry under the archway.

examples.text: Henri range toujours chaque outil à sa place après usage.
examples.trans: Henri always puts every tool back in its place after using it.

meanings.note: Adjective (*un rythme rapide*, 'a fast rhythm'), whereas *vite* is normally an adverb ('quickly').

examples.text: Le premier mouvement est vif et rapide, puis la musique ralentit.
examples.trans: The first movement is bright and fast, then the music slows down.

examples.text: C'est une recette rapide pour le déjeuner de midi.
examples.trans: It's a quick recipe for midday lunch.

meanings.note: Manner adverb formed by adding '-ment' (from Latin 'mente', 'with a ... mind') to the feminine adjective stem.

examples.text: Il lit le texte rapidement.
examples.trans: He reads the text quickly.

examples.text: D'accord, je vais le lire rapidement.
examples.trans: All right, I will read it quickly.

examples.text: Le bilan de fin d'année approche rapidement.
examples.trans: The year-end review is approaching quickly.

meanings.en: to call back, to phone again
meanings.note: Rappeler quelque chose à quelqu'un.
Rappeler quelque chose à quelqu'un.

examples.text: Je vous rappelle dans dix minutes.
examples.trans: I'll call you back in ten minutes.

examples.text: Rappelle la gare, s'il te plaît.
examples.trans: Call the station back, please.

meanings.note: avoir un rapport avec = to be related to
avoir un rapport avec = to be related to

examples.text: Le rapport du ministère sur le financement du cinéma.
examples.trans: The ministry report on cinema funding.

examples.text: J'ai lu votre rapport.
examples.trans: I read your report.

meanings.note: Built from re- + apporter.

examples.text: Pas une seule fissure! Qui l'a rapportée?
examples.trans: Not a single crack! Who brought it back?

examples.text: Voici cinquante euros de la caisse. Rapportez le ticket!
examples.trans: Here is fifty euros from the cash box. Bring back the receipt!

meanings.note: Rapprocher deux personnes. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to bring closer'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'rapproché').
Reflexive. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to bring closer'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'rapproché').

examples.text: Quelque chose qui nous rapprocherait un jour.
examples.trans: Something that would bring us closer one day.

examples.text: Se rapprocher du but.
examples.trans: To get closer to the goal.

examples.text: Quelque chose de plus profond, qui nous rapprocherait un jour.
examples.trans: Something deeper, that would bring us closer one day.

meanings.note: Scarce or uncommon; the singular form is the same for either gender.

examples.text: Les grands rôles sont rares.
examples.trans: Big parts are rare.

examples.text: C'est très rare.
examples.trans: It's very rare.

examples.text: Mais les grands rôles sont rares pour une femme de mon âge.
examples.trans: But big parts are rare for a woman my age.

meanings.note: Rarely or seldom; contrasts with souvent, often.

examples.text: Je la vois rarement.
examples.trans: I rarely see her.

examples.text: Il sort rarement le soir.
examples.trans: He rarely goes out in the evening.

examples.text: C'est merveilleux. On la voit si rarement à l'écran.
examples.trans: That's wonderful. We see her so rarely on screen.

meanings.note: se raser la barbe = to shave one's beard

examples.text: Le type se rase le matin.
examples.trans: The guy shaves in the morning.

examples.text: Il rase les murs.
examples.trans: He hugs the walls.

examples.text: Le type se rase, personne ne remarque.
examples.trans: The guy shaves, nobody notices.

meanings.en: to bring together, gather (people or objects)
meanings.note: Built from re- + assembler; warm verb for a place or tradition that brings neighbours together.

examples.text: Le thé du vendredi rassemblait tous les habitants de la rue.
examples.trans: Friday tea used to bring together everyone on the street.

examples.text: Claire rassemble les cartes postales sur le comptoir.
examples.trans: Claire gathers the postcards together on the counter.

meanings.note: Makes someone feel calmer or less worried; feminine rassurante pronounces the t.

examples.text: Je ne suis pas rassurante?
examples.trans: I'm not reassuring?

examples.text: C'est rassurant.
examples.trans: That's reassuring.

examples.text: Je ne suis pas rassurante pour mes clients?
examples.trans: I'm not reassuring for my clients?

meanings.en: to reassure, comfort, put at ease
meanings.note: se rassurer = to reassure oneself, calm down
se rassurer = to reassure oneself, calm down

examples.text: Rassurez-vous! Nous avons préparé notre chambre calme sous les toits juste pour vous.
examples.trans: Rest assured! We prepared our quiet attic room just for you.

examples.text: Rassure-toi, tout va bien.
examples.trans: Don't worry, everything is fine.

examples.text: Rassurez-vous!
examples.trans: Rest assured!

meanings.note: A train, a plane, an opportunity.
Informal.

examples.text: Tu vas rater ton avion.
examples.trans: You're going to miss your plane.

examples.text: J'ai raté le film.
examples.trans: I missed the film.

rattraper.gloss: to catch up on, to make up for

meanings.en: to catch up on, to make up for
meanings.note: rattraper le retard = to catch up on the delay

examples.text: On peut rattraper le retard.
examples.trans: We can catch up on the delay.

examples.text: Je vais te rattraper.
examples.trans: I am going to catch up with you.

related.gloss: to catch up on the delay

meanings.note: Feminine: ratée. Masculine noun ('le raté', plural 'les ratés') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'failure'.

examples.text: Il a peur de passer pour un raté devant son père.
examples.trans: He's afraid of looking like a failure in front of his father.

examples.text: Après ce film raté, il cherche un meilleur scénario.
examples.trans: After that failed film, he is looking for a better script.

examples.text: Je suis un raté.
examples.trans: I am a failure.

meanings.note: Ravi de plus infinitive: delighted to do something.

examples.text: Elle est ravie de venir.
examples.trans: She's delighted to come.

examples.text: Nous sommes ravis que notre cour soit paisible pour votre... travail.
examples.trans: We are delighted that our courtyard is peaceful for your... work.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'ravishing'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Une ravissante amie.
examples.trans: A ravishing friend.

examples.text: C'est qui, ta ravissante amie?
examples.trans: Who is your ravishing friend?

meanings.en: to scratch, cross off, strike out
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to scratch'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'rayé').

examples.text: Je refuse d'être rayé de sa vie.
examples.trans: I refuse to be erased from her life.

examples.text: Il raye son nom de la liste.
examples.trans: He crosses his name off the list.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le rayon', plural 'les rayons') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'bookstore department'.

examples.text: Allons voir ce rayon.
examples.trans: Let us go see this section.

examples.text: Pourquoi pas, allons voir ce rayon ensemble!
examples.trans: Why not, let us go see this section together!

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'radiant'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Elle est rayonnante de bonheur.
examples.trans: She is radiant with happiness.

examples.text: Un sourire rayonnant.
examples.trans: A radiant smile.

examples.text: Depuis leur rencontre, Sofia est rayonnante.
examples.trans: Since their meeting, Sofia is radiant.

meanings.note: Fine scratch on glass or metal; woven or painted stripe ('à rayures' = striped).

examples.text: Le verre de la boussole n'a pas la moindre rayure.
examples.trans: The glass of the compass doesn't have a single scratch.

examples.text: Il porte un tablier en coton bleu à rayures blanches.
examples.trans: He wears a blue cotton apron with white stripes.

meanings.note: Patterned with stripes ('une boîte à chapeau rayée' = a striped hatbox), or scratched.

examples.text: Ne vous inquiétez pas, Odette; voici la boîte à chapeau rayée bien en sécurité devant la chambre six!
examples.trans: Do not worry, Odette; here sits the striped hatbox safe and sound outside Room Six!

examples.text: Le boulanger porte un grand tablier rayé bleu et blanc.
examples.trans: The baker wears a large blue-and-white striped apron.

meanings.note: French relational/descriptive adjective derived from Latin adjectival roots. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Une femme rebelle.
examples.trans: A rebellious woman.

examples.text: Un esprit rebelle.
examples.trans: A rebel spirit.

examples.text: Tu es une femme libre et rebelle.
examples.trans: You are a free and rebellious woman.

meanings.note: After a failure.
After a failure.

examples.text: On va rebondir.
examples.trans: We'll bounce back.

examples.text: La balle rebondit.
examples.trans: The ball bounces.

meanings.note: Friendly greeting on seeing someone a second time that day.

examples.text: Rebonjour, Madame Odette! Vous voulez du café ou du thé noir?
examples.trans: Good morning again, Madam Odette! Would you like coffee or black tea?

examples.text: Rebonjour, Madame Odette!
examples.trans: Good morning again, Madam Odette!

meanings.note: Raised rim of a fountain basin, windowsill ('rebord de fenêtre'), or stone ledge.

examples.text: Un chat roux dort au soleil sur le rebord de la fenêtre.
examples.trans: A ginger cat sleeps in the sun on the windowsill.

examples.text: Elle s'assoit un moment sur le rebord frais du bassin.
examples.trans: She sits for a moment on the cool rim of the fountain basin.

meanings.en: reverse order (in compte à rebours = countdown; à rebours = backwards)
meanings.note: Final -s is silent (/ʁəbuʁ/). Almost always met in un compte à rebours ('a countdown') and à rebours ('backwards, against the grain').

examples.text: À cinq jours de l'ouverture, le compte à rebours est lancé!
examples.trans: With five days until opening, the countdown is on!

examples.text: Tout le monde compte à rebours avant d'allumer la guirlande.
examples.trans: Everyone counts down before switching on the string of lights.

meanings.note: Culinary recipe; box-office or shop takings.

examples.text: Cette recette de tarte aux amandes se transmet dans la famille.
examples.trans: This almond tart recipe has been passed down in the family.

examples.text: Elle a noté toute la recette à la plume sur un bristol.
examples.trans: She wrote down the whole recipe in fountain pen on a note card.

meanings.note: Cedilla *ç* appears before *o* and *u* (*je reçois, j'ai reçu*) to keep the soft `/s/` sound.

examples.text: Nous avons reçu douze assiettes blanches ce matin.
examples.trans: We received twelve white plates this morning.

examples.text: Chaque plante du jardin reçoit la lumière du matin.
examples.trans: Every garden plant gets the morning light.

meanings.note: Une pièce / vanne de rechange = a spare part / valve.

examples.text: Vous avez une vanne de rechange dans votre caisse à outils?
examples.trans: Do you have a spare valve in your toolbox?

examples.text: Voici le rechange sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the replacement, spare on the table.

meanings.en: faire des recherches = to do research, to read up
meanings.note: À la recherche de.
À la recherche de.

examples.text: J'ai fait des recherches.

examples.text: Elle fait des recherches pour son film.
examples.trans: She is doing research for her film.

rechercher.gloss: to seek out, to look for

meanings.en: to seek out, to look for, to be in high demand
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to seek out'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'recherché').

examples.text: Un profil très recherché.
examples.trans: A very sought-after profile.

examples.text: Rechercher la vérité.
examples.trans: To seek the truth.

examples.text: Mon profil est très recherché aujourd'hui.
examples.trans: My profile is very sought after today.

meanings.note: Lettre recommandée = registered letter.

examples.text: Pire qu'un tuyau... une lettre recommandée du propriétaire de l'immeuble est arrivée à midi.
examples.trans: Worse than a pipe... a registered letter from the building owner arrived at noon.

examples.text: C'est facile à recommander ensemble.
examples.trans: It is easy to register together.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le recommandé', plural 'les recommandés') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'registered mail'.

examples.text: Une lettre recommandée est arrivée.
examples.trans: A registered letter arrived.

examples.text: un recommandé.
examples.trans: a registered letter.

recommencer.gloss: to start again, to do again

meanings.en: to start again, to begin again
meanings.note: nous recommençons takes ç before -ons

examples.text: Bon, on recommence.
examples.trans: Right, let's start again.

examples.text: On recommence depuis le début.
examples.trans: Let's start again from the beginning.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la reconnaissance', plural 'les reconnaissances') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'legal recognition'.

examples.text: Exprimer sa profonde reconnaissance.
examples.trans: To express one's deep gratitude.

examples.text: La procédure de reconnaissance de paternité de Mathias.
examples.trans: Mathias's paternity recognition procedure.

meanings.note: Third-group irregular verb inherited from core Latin roots ('-ere'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Core French verb meaning 'to recognize'.

examples.text: J'ai reconnu ton écriture carrée sur cette carte postale en deux secondes.
examples.trans: I recognized your neat block handwriting on that postcard in two seconds.

meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to win back'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: Il fait tout pour reconquérir le cœur de sa femme.
examples.trans: He is doing everything to win back his wife's heart.

examples.text: Ce rôle va lui permettre de reconquérir son public.
examples.trans: This role will allow him to win back his audience.

meanings.note: Recruter un candidat. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to recruit'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'recruté').

examples.trans: She is not the one who is hiring!

examples.text: L'agence recrute un assistant.
examples.trans: The agency is hiring an assistant.

examples.text: Arlette? Mais ce n'est pas elle qui recrute!
examples.trans: Arlette? But she is not the one hiring!

meanings.note: prendre du recul = to take a step back / gain perspective
Le recul d'une arme. Masculine noun ('le recul', plural 'les reculs') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'distance'.

examples.text: Prendre du recul!
examples.trans: Take a step back!

examples.text: Avoir du recul sur la situation.
examples.trans: To have perspective on the situation.

examples.text: Une respiration! Prendre du recul!
examples.trans: A breather! Taking a step back!

reculer.gloss: to back up, retreat, shrink back

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to shrink back'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reculé').

examples.trans: You stop at nothing.

examples.text: Et la théière est bien chaude! Tout le monde recule loin de la fenêtre!
examples.trans: And the teapot is piping hot! Everybody step back from the window!

meanings.en: to become again, return to being
meanings.note: reprendre son état antérieur; uses être as auxiliary

examples.text: Tu dois redevenir un acteur.
examples.trans: You must become an actor again.

examples.text: Le temps redevient calme.
examples.trans: The weather is becoming calm again.

examples.text: Tu dois redevenir un acteur maintenant.
examples.trans: You must become an actor again now.

meanings.note: redonner confiance = to restore confidence

examples.text: Cela m'a redonné le sourire.
examples.trans: That brought back my smile.

examples.text: Comment faisiez-vous pour lui redonner le sourire, Madame Odette?
examples.trans: How did you bring his smile back, Madam Odette?

meanings.note: Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: C'est une rivale redoutable.
examples.trans: She is a formidable rival.

examples.text: StarMédia est une rivale redoutable.

examples.text: Élise Formain est une femme redoutable.
examples.trans: Elise Formain is a formidable woman.

meanings.note: Built from re- + dresser.

examples.text: C'est facile à redresser ensemble.
examples.trans: It is easy to straighten together.

refermer.gloss: to close again, shut back up

meanings.note: Built from re- + fermer.

examples.trans: Quick, close it! Let us take it upstairs right away... wait, what is that loud metallic noise?

examples.text: C'est facile à refermer ensemble.
examples.trans: It is easy to close again, shut back up together.

meanings.en: to pass off, dump on someone, palm off (colloquial)

examples.trans: He is passing me a hot potato!

examples.trans: Do not dump this file on me.

related.gloss: to pass something off onto someone

meanings.note: Un reflet sur la vitre = a reflection on the windowpane.

meanings.en: to cool down, get cold, chill
meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to cool down'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le refuge', plural 'les refuges') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'shelter'.
Masculine noun ('le refuge', plural 'les refuges') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'mountain refuge'.

examples.trans: Welcome to our shelter for elderly animals.

examples.text: Ils ont trouvé un refuge sûr.

meanings.en: look, gaze, expression in the eyes

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la reine', plural 'les reines') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'queen'.
Feminine noun ('la reine', plural 'les reines') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'ma petite reine'.

examples.trans: On set, this great actress is treated like a queen.

Rejeter. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to reject'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'rejeté').

examples.text: Vous avez rejeté mon scénario autrefois.
examples.trans: You rejected my screenplay in the past.

examples.text: Il rejette toutes mes propositions.
examples.trans: He rejects all my suggestions.

examples.text: Je relis encore mon scénario rejeté.
examples.trans: I am rereading my rejected screenplay again.

meanings.note: To catch up or meet up with someone; for two paths or lines to meet ('se rejoindre').

examples.text: Je vous rejoins sur la place dès que le four est éteint.
examples.trans: I'll meet you on the square as soon as the oven is off.

examples.text: Les deux allées ombragées se rejoignent devant la fontaine.
examples.trans: The two shaded paths meet in front of the fountain.

related.gloss: to get back, recover, find again

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le relais', plural 'les relais') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'relay'.

examples.text: Je prends le relais pour la nuit.
examples.trans: I take over for the night.

examples.text: Repose-toi, je prends le relais.
examples.trans: Rest, I take over now.

meanings.note: Une relation entre deux personnes.
Avoir des relations.

examples.text: Je ne vais pas sacrifier notre relation pour un film.
examples.trans: I'm not going to sacrifice our relationship for a film.

examples.text: Ils ont une bonne relation.
examples.trans: They have a good relationship.

relever.gloss: to get back up ('se relever'); to lift up

meanings.en: to lift up; reflexive *se relever*: to get back up, stand back up
meanings.note: Stem changes *e -> è* before silent endings (*ne te relève pas!*, 'don't get back up!').

examples.text: Reste assis une minute, ne te relève pas trop vite.
examples.trans: Stay seated for a minute, don't get back up too fast.

examples.text: Il relève doucement le couvercle en bois du piano.
examples.trans: He gently lifts up the wooden piano lid.

meanings.note: avoir du relief = to have character/depth

examples.text: Elle cherche une femme avec du relief.
examples.trans: She is looking for a woman with character.

examples.text: Un rôle qui a du relief.
examples.trans: A role that has depth.

meanings.note: To read a letter, clue, or proof a second time.

examples.text: Relisons l'énigme lentement pour ne manquer aucun détail.
examples.trans: Let's reread the riddle slowly so we don't miss a single detail.

examples.text: J'aime relire ce roman chaque été sous le tilleul.
examples.trans: I love rereading this novel every summer under the linden tree.

relâcher.gloss: to release, to relax, to let go
