meanings.note: Tirez, relâchez = pull, release. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to release'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'relâché').
Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to release'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'relâché').

examples.text: Tirez, relâchez!
examples.trans: Pull, release!

examples.text: Relâchez vos épaules.
examples.trans: Relax your shoulders.

examples.text: Tirez, relâchez! C'est un peu mou.
examples.trans: Pull, release! It is a bit slack.

meanings.en: prendre la relève = to take over
meanings.note: Prendre la relève means taking over duties from someone else, not buying a company.

examples.text: Je suis prête à prendre la relève.
examples.trans: I'm ready to take over.

examples.text: Qui prend la relève?
examples.trans: Who's taking over?

examples.text: Je comprends. Je suis prête à prendre la relève.
examples.trans: I understand. I'm ready to take over.

meanings.note: Un travail remarquable. Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Vous parlez un anglais remarquable, apparemment.
examples.trans: You speak remarkable English, apparently.

examples.text: Elle a fait des progrès remarquables.
examples.trans: She made remarkable progress.

examples.text: C'est grâce à ton travail remarquable.
examples.trans: It is thanks to your remarkable work.

meanings.note: To a striking or remarkable degree.
Built from remarquable ('remarkable') + -ment.

examples.text: Hé! Ce monsieur distingué près du portail est remarquablement élégant, merci beaucoup!
examples.trans: Hey! That distinguished gentleman near the gate is remarkably handsome, thank you very much!

examples.text: Après trente ans sous la pierre, la boussole fonctionne remarquablement bien.
examples.trans: After thirty years under the stone, the compass works remarkably well.

meanings.note: Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'remark, comment'.

examples.text: J'ai l'habitude de ces remarques.
examples.trans: I am used to these remarks.

examples.text: Faire une remarque.
examples.trans: To make a remark.

meanings.note: remarquer un détail = to notice a detail

examples.text: Personne ne remarque le changement.
examples.trans: Nobody notices the change.

examples.text: Elle a remarqué mon absence.
examples.trans: She noticed my absence.

examples.text: Le type se rase, personne ne remarque.
examples.trans: The guy shaves, nobody notices.

meanings.note: Demander un remboursement = to ask for a refund.

examples.text: Alors? Il a crié? Il a demandé un remboursement?
examples.trans: Well? Did he shout? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: Voici le remboursement sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the refund, reimbursement on the table.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to reimburse'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'remboursé').

examples.text: Les assurances remboursent les frais.
examples.trans: Insurances reimburse the costs.

examples.text: L'agence va rembourser la somme.
examples.trans: The agency will refund the sum.

examples.text: Les assurances remboursent généralement ces frais imprévus.
examples.trans: Insurances generally reimburse these unforeseen costs.

meanings.note: remercier quelqu'un de/pour quelque chose

examples.text: Je vous remercie.
examples.trans: Thank you (formal).

examples.text: Ni l'un ni l'autre! Il a adoré les poutres calmes et nous a remerciés.
examples.trans: Neither! He loved the quiet beams and thanked us.

meanings.en: to put back in place, reseat
meanings.note: Conjugated exactly like *mettre* (*j'ai remis*).

examples.text: Il remet le petit axe en laiton à sa place avec précaution.
examples.trans: He carefully puts the small brass pin back in place.

examples.text: Remettez le couvercle sur le pot pour garder le sucre au sec.
examples.trans: Put the lid back on the jar to keep the sugar dry.

remonter.gloss: to spring back, rise again; go back up

meanings.en: to spring back up (of kneaded dough); to go back upstairs
meanings.note: La pâte remonte toute seule = the dough springs right back.

examples.text: Quand la pâte est prête, elle remonte doucement sous le doigt.
examples.trans: When the dough is ready, it springs gently back under your finger.

examples.text: Je remonte chercher mon violon dans la chambre quatre.
examples.trans: I am going back upstairs to get my violin from Room 4.

meanings.note: Put someone or something in another's place.
Can refer to a temporary stand-in as well as a permanent replacement.

examples.text: On va remplacer Françoise?
examples.trans: Are we going to replace Françoise?

examples.text: Je te remplace demain.
examples.trans: I'll stand in for you tomorrow.

examples.text: On n'est pas obligés de remplacer Françoise Fabian.
examples.trans: We don't have to replace Françoise Fabian.

meanings.note: Feminine: remplaçante.

examples.text: Vous cherchez une remplaçante?
examples.trans: You're looking for a replacement?

examples.text: Le remplaçant arrive demain.
examples.trans: The substitute arrives tomorrow.

meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to fill up'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: La salle est déjà bien remplie.
examples.trans: The hall is already well filled.

examples.text: Il remplit son verre d'eau.
examples.trans: He fills his glass of water.

examples.text: Je tourne doucement... écoutez! L'eau remplit le tuyau!
examples.trans: Turning slowly... listen! Water is filling the pipe!

remporter.gloss: to win, carry off, take away

meanings.en: to win an award or victory
meanings.note: Remporter un prix / la victoire. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to win'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'remporté').
Remporter ses affaires. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to win'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'remporté').

examples.text: Votre premier film a remporté un prix.
examples.trans: Your first movie won a prize.

examples.text: L'acteur a remporté un César.
examples.trans: The actor won a César.

examples.text: Une autre actrice a remporté le trophée!
examples.trans: Another actress won the trophy!

meanings.en: to stir (paint, soup, tea); to wiggle, move
meanings.note: Standard everyday verb for stirring a pot of soup or a tin of paint before use (*remuer la peinture*).

examples.text: Remuez bien la peinture avec une baguette en bois avant de commencer.
examples.trans: Stir the paint well with a wooden stick before starting.

examples.text: Laissez cuire la soupe à feu doux en remuant de temps en temps.
examples.trans: Let the soup cook over low heat, stirring occasionally.

meanings.note: Faire une rencontre. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'meeting, encounter'.

examples.text: Je veux organiser une rencontre.
examples.trans: I want to set up a meeting.

examples.text: C'est une belle rencontre.
examples.trans: It is a wonderful encounter.

examples.text: Je veux organiser une rencontre avec Steven Spielberg, qui est à Paris.
examples.trans: I want to set up a meeting with Steven Spielberg, who is in Paris.

meanings.note: For meeting someone, often for the first time or by chance; not necessarily an arranged appointment.

examples.text: Je ne vais pas rencontrer quelqu'un ici.
examples.trans: I'm not going to meet anyone here.

examples.text: On s'est rencontrés à Paris.
examples.trans: We met in Paris.

examples.text: C'était mon plan lâche de lundi... avant de vous rencontrer tous.
examples.trans: That was my cowardly Monday plan... before meeting all of you.

meanings.note: avoir rendez-vous avec = to have an appointment with

examples.text: Sans rendez-vous?
examples.trans: Without an appointment?

examples.text: J'ai rendez-vous à onze heures.
examples.trans: I have an appointment at eleven.

rendre.gloss: to give back, to return; to make (someone happy/sad)

meanings.note: Rendre quelque chose à quelqu'un.
Rendre service = to do a favour.

examples.text: Parce que le bon café et le pain chaud rendent les gens sympas!
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people friendly!

examples.text: Personne ne fixe les clients. On rend le sac et on fait son travail.
examples.trans: Nobody stares at guests. We hand back the bag and do our job.

examples.text: Rends-moi mon livre.
examples.trans: Give me back my book.

meanings.en: to give up, surrender, renounce (renoncer à)
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to give up'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'renoncé').

examples.text: Je ne veux pas renoncer.
examples.trans: I do not want to give up.

examples.text: Il renonce à son projet.
examples.trans: He renounces his project.

examples.text: Mais je ne voulais pas renoncer.
examples.trans: But I did not want to give up.

meanings.en: se renseigner = to find out, inquire
meanings.note: Reflexive. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to inform'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'renseigné').

meanings.en: renseigner quelqu'un = to give someone information
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to inform'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'renseigné').

examples.text: Alors renseigne-toi vite!
examples.trans: Then find out quickly!

examples.text: Je vais me renseigner.
examples.trans: I will inquire.

examples.text: Bonsoir Andréa, je me suis renseignée sur vous.
examples.trans: Good evening Andrea, I looked into your background.

rentrer.gloss: to go home, to come back

meanings.en: to go home, to get back
meanings.note: Uses être in the compound past when it means returning home.

meanings.en: to go in, to come in
meanings.note: Informal for entrer.

examples.text: On est rentrés chez moi.
examples.trans: We went back to my place.

examples.text: Je rentre à huit heures.
examples.trans: I get home at eight.

meanings.en: to spill (a drink), tip or knock over
meanings.note: Covers both knocking over a cup and spilling the liquid inside (*renverser son café*).

examples.text: Attention à ne pas renverser votre tasse de café sur le carnet!
examples.trans: Careful not to spill your cup of coffee on the notebook!

examples.text: Le vent a presque renversé le petit pot de fleurs.
examples.trans: The wind nearly knocked over the small flowerpot.

renvoyer.gloss: to fire, to dismiss, to send back

meanings.en: to fire, to dismiss; to send back
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to fire'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'renvoyé').

examples.text: Si tu veux me renvoyer.
examples.trans: If you want to fire me.

examples.text: Renvoyer un employé.
examples.trans: To dismiss an employee.

examples.text: Merci à vous deux d'avoir été honnêtes au lieu de me renvoyer sous la pluie.
examples.trans: Thank you both for being honest instead of sending me back into the rain.

meanings.note: En reparler plus tard. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to discuss again'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reparlé').

examples.text: Parfait, nous en reparlerons très vite ensemble.
examples.trans: Perfect, we will discuss it very soon together.

examples.text: Nous en reparlerons demain matin au bureau.
examples.trans: We will discuss it again tomorrow morning at the office.

examples.text: Ce n'est pas possible, on en reparle.
examples.trans: That is not possible, we will talk later.

repartir.gloss: set off again; start from scratch

meanings.en: to leave again, set off again; to start afresh (repartir de zéro)
meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Core French verb meaning 'set off again; start from scratch'.

examples.text: On repart de zéro.
examples.trans: We are starting from scratch.

examples.text: Même s'il fait demi-tour et repart tout droit par le portail.
examples.trans: Even if he turns around and walks straight back out the gate.

meanings.en: meal (food eaten at a regular occasion)
meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le repas', plural 'les repas') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'meal'.

examples.text: S'occuper des repas des enfants.
examples.trans: Taking care of the children's meals.

examples.text: Partager un bon repas en famille.
examples.trans: To share a good meal with family.

examples.text: S'occuper des repas et des changes?
examples.trans: Taking care of meals and changes?

meanings.note: Repasser une cravate / une chemise.

examples.text: Quinze ans à frotter des clés en laiton et à repasser mes cravates... finis en trente jours!
examples.trans: Fifteen years polishing brass keys and ironing my ties... gone in thirty days!

examples.text: C'est facile à repasser ensemble.
examples.trans: It is easy to iron together.

meanings.note: Conjugates like peindre: je repeins, nous repeignons.

examples.text: Sûrement un avis ennuyeux pour repeindre les volets sur la rue.
examples.trans: Probably a boring notice about repainting the street shutters.

examples.text: C'est facile à repeindre ensemble.
examples.trans: It is easy to repaint together.

meanings.note: repenser à un souvenir = to think back to a memory

examples.text: Je repense souvent à ce jour.
examples.trans: I often think back to that day.

examples.text: Repenser une stratégie.
examples.trans: To rethink a strategy.

examples.text: Je repense souvent à ce billet de train.
examples.trans: I often think back to that train ticket.

meanings.note: To fold a map, letter, or tablecloth neatly back along its creases.

examples.text: Je replie la carte suivant ses plis d'origine.
examples.trans: I fold the map back along its original creases.

examples.text: Quand l'averse cesse, on replie les grands parapluies.
examples.trans: When the shower stops, everyone folds up the big umbrellas.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to dive back'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'replongé').
Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to fall back into'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'replongé').

examples.text: Tu ne replonges pas, hein?
examples.trans: You are not falling back into it, are you?

examples.text: Il a peur de replonger dans ses travers.
examples.trans: He is afraid of falling back into his old ways.

meanings.en: to postpone, to defer, to reschedule
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to postpone'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reporté').

examples.text: Reporter ce tournage de deux mois.
examples.trans: To postpone this shoot by two months.

examples.text: Vous devez simplement reporter ce tournage.
examples.trans: You must simply postpone this shoot.

examples.text: Peut-on reporter ce rendez-vous photo important?
examples.trans: Can we postpone this important photo shoot?

meanings.note: avoir besoin de repos = to need rest

examples.text: Nathalie a besoin de repos.
examples.trans: Nathalie needs rest.

examples.text: Prendre du repos.
examples.trans: To take a rest.

examples.text: Nathalie a besoin de deux semaines de repos.
examples.trans: Nathalie needs two weeks of rest.

meanings.en: to rest; se reposer = to rest oneself
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to rest'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reposé').

examples.text: Reposez-vous bien, madame. Sonnez si vous avez besoin de quelque chose.
examples.trans: Rest well, madam. Ring if you need anything.

examples.text: Promets-moi de te reposer.
examples.trans: Promise me to rest.

reprendre.gloss: to take back; to start again, to pick up

meanings.en: to start again, to resume, to pick up
meanings.note: Les affaires reprennent.

meanings.en: to take back, to have more of

examples.text: On reprend le travail.
examples.trans: We're going back to work.

examples.text: Reprendre mon souffle? Jamais!
examples.trans: Catch my breath? Never!

meanings.en: to reproach, to criticize someone for something
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to reproach'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'reproché').

examples.text: Ne me reproche rien.
examples.trans: Do not blame me for anything.

examples.text: Reprocher une erreur.
examples.trans: To reproach a mistake.

examples.text: C'est injuste de me reprocher cela.
examples.trans: It is unfair to blame me for that.

meanings.note: Masculine counterpart: un représentant.

examples.text: La représentante de la mairie visite la cour à quinze heures.
examples.trans: The City Hall representative visits the courtyard at three p.m.

examples.text: Nous accueillons la représentante du quartier avec du thé chaud.
examples.trans: We welcome the neighborhood representative with hot tea.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la représentation', plural 'les représentations') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'theatrical performance'.

examples.text: C'était une belle représentation.
examples.trans: It was a fine performance.

examples.text: C'était une représentation vraiment intense.
examples.trans: It was a truly intense performance.

meanings.note: An agent represents an actor.

examples.text: Cette agence ne représente que des stars.
examples.trans: This agency only represents stars.

examples.text: Qui vous représente?
examples.trans: Who represents you?

meanings.note: Repérer de nouveaux talents. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to spot'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'repéré').

examples.text: C'est difficile de repérer les jeunes.
examples.trans: It is hard to spot young actors.

examples.text: Je l'ai repéré dans la foule.
examples.trans: I spotted him in the crowd.

examples.text: Exactement, je repère les futures stars.
examples.trans: Exactly, I scout future stars.

meanings.note: Also a ruthless person.

examples.text: Elle est pleine de requins.
examples.trans: It's full of sharks.

examples.text: Attention aux requins!
examples.trans: Watch out for sharks!

meanings.note: Final ct is silent.

examples.text: Respect, monsieur Barneville!
examples.trans: Respect, Mr Barneville!

examples.text: J'ai beaucoup de respect pour elle.
examples.trans: I have a lot of respect for her.

examples.text: Vivre dangereusement! Respect, monsieur Barneville!
examples.trans: Living dangerously! Respect, Mr Barneville!

meanings.note: Respect a person, decision or rule; takes its object directly.

examples.text: Je respecte votre décision.
examples.trans: I respect your decision.

examples.text: Il respecte ses clients.
examples.trans: He respects his clients.

examples.text: Non, Claire, soyons francs! Monsieur, nous respectons beaucoup le Guide de Lyon!
examples.trans: No, Claire, let us be frank! Sir, we deeply respect the Lyon Guide!

meanings.note: Figurative: une respiration. Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'breathing, breath, breather'.

Figurative: une respiration. Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'breathing, breath, breather'.

examples.text: Une respiration!
examples.trans: A breather!

examples.text: Une respiration profonde.
examples.trans: A deep breath.

examples.text: Une respiration! Prendre du recul!
examples.trans: A breather! Taking a step back!

examples.text: Respire calmement.
examples.trans: Breathe calmly.

examples.text: Respirez un grand coup, Étienne.
examples.trans: Take a deep breath, Etienne.

meanings.note: A strong compliment.

examples.text: Vous êtes resplendissante.
examples.trans: You look radiant.

examples.text: Il est resplendissant ce matin.
examples.trans: He looks great this morning.

meanings.note: Feminine abstract noun formed with '-ité' (from Latin '-itas', English '-ity'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'responsibility'.

examples.text: Prendre la responsabilité.
examples.trans: To take responsibility.

examples.text: J'assume l'entière responsabilité.
examples.trans: I take full responsibility.

meanings.note: Responsable de = responsible for. Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Pas touche, Nadia! Claire, voulez-vous rester comme responsable de la réception pour de bon?
examples.trans: Hands off, Nadia! Claire, would you stay as permanent front-desk manager?

examples.text: Il est responsable du projet.
examples.trans: He is responsible for the project.

meanings.note: ressembler à quelqu'un = to look like someone (indirect object: lui ressembler)

examples.text: Mais tu lui ressembles vraiment!
examples.trans: But you really look like him!

examples.text: Elle ressemble à sa mère.
examples.trans: She looks like her mother.

meanings.note: Éprouver du ressentiment. Masculine action/result noun formed with the Romance suffix '-ment' (from Latin '-mentum'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard masculine noun meaning 'resentment, grievance'.

examples.text: Le ressentiment est voulu.
examples.trans: Resentment is deliberate.

examples.text: Nourrir du ressentiment.
examples.trans: To harbor resentment.

examples.text: C'est quoi exactement? De la rancœur? Du ressentiment?
examples.trans: What is it exactly? Rancor? Resentment?

meanings.en: to feel, experience, perceive (a sensation or emotion)
meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire') meaning 'to feel'; essential in everyday spoken and professional French.

examples.text: Quand je ressentirai le besoin.
examples.trans: When I will feel the need.

examples.text: Ressentir une grande joie.
examples.trans: To feel great joy.

examples.text: Je te demanderai quand je ressentirai le besoin.
examples.trans: I will ask you when I feel the need.

meanings.note: Resserrer une vis = to tighten a screw.

examples.text: Attention à cette chaise du coin, attendez dix secondes, je resserre cette vis.
examples.trans: Watch that corner chair, wait ten seconds while I tighten this screw.

examples.text: C'est facile à resserrer ensemble.
examples.trans: It is easy to tighten together.

ressortir.gloss: to come out again, to resurface

meanings.en: to come out again, resurface, emerge
meanings.note: French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire'). Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Core French verb meaning 'to come out again, to resurface'.

examples.text: Les vieux dossiers ressortent.
examples.trans: The old files come out.

examples.text: Sinon les vieux dossiers ressortent.
examples.trans: Otherwise the old files come out.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le restaurant', plural 'les restaurants') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'restaurant'.

examples.text: On se retrouve au restaurant.
examples.trans: We meet at the restaurant.

examples.text: On se retrouve bientôt au restaurant?
examples.trans: Are we meeting soon at the restaurant?

examples.text: Le restaurant, ça va être compliqué.
examples.trans: The restaurant, that will be complicated.

meanings.en: to restore (a historic room, painting, or instrument)
meanings.note: Restaurer un jardin d'hiver = restore a historic sunroom.

examples.text: Ils ont restauré le jardin d'hiver sans toucher aux arches.
examples.trans: They restored the sunroom without altering the arches.

examples.text: Le luthier restaure un violon vieux de cent ans.
examples.trans: The luthier is restoring a hundred-year-old violin.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le reste', plural 'les restes') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'rest'.

examples.text: Le reste de ma vie.
examples.trans: The rest of my life.

examples.text: Disons, le reste de ma vie.
examples.trans: Say, the rest of my life.

examples.text: Je reste avec toi.
examples.trans: I am staying with you.

meanings.note: Passé composé with être.

examples.text: Je reste à Paris.
examples.trans: I'm staying in Paris.

examples.text: Elle est restée à l'agence.
examples.trans: She stayed with the agency.

meanings.note: Être en retard.
Être en retard.

examples.text: Je suis en retard.
examples.trans: I'm late.

examples.text: Le train a du retard.
examples.trans: The train is delayed.

meanings.note: Une bombe à retardement.

examples.text: C'est une bombe à retardement.
examples.trans: It's a time bomb.

examples.text: Un effet à retardement.
examples.trans: A delayed effect.

meanings.en: to remember, to keep in mind
meanings.note: Retenez is the polite/plural command: remember or keep in mind.

examples.text: Retenez ce nom, elle est fantastique!
examples.trans: Remember that name, she's fantastic!

examples.text: Je ne retiens jamais les dates.
examples.trans: I never remember dates.

examples.text: Bonjour Thibault, merci d'être venu. D'accord, je peux retenir ça.
examples.trans: Hello Thibault, thank you for coming. Okay, I can remember that.

retirer.gloss: to pull back, to take off, to withdraw

meanings.note: je l'ai vite retiré = I quickly pulled it back
Retirer de l'argent.

meanings.en: se retirer = to withdraw, pull out
meanings.note: Reflexive; here the buyer withdraws from buying the agency.

cells: il s’est retiré / elle s’est retirée
ils se sont retirés / elles se sont retirées

examples.text: Je l'ai vite retiré.
examples.trans: I quickly pulled it back.

examples.text: Il retire sa veste.
examples.trans: He takes off his jacket.

examples.text: L'acheteur se retire.
examples.trans: The buyer pulls out.

meanings.en: to fall again, land (retomber sur ses pieds = land on one's feet)
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to fall again'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'retombé').

examples.text: Elle retombe sur ses pieds.
examples.trans: She lands on her feet.

examples.text: Le silence est retombé.
examples.trans: Silence fell again.

examples.text: Elle retombe toujours sur ses pieds!
examples.trans: She always lands on her feet!

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to retouch photos or text'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'retouché').

examples.text: Cette photo a été trop retouchée.
examples.trans: This photo was retouched too much.

examples.text: Cette image est tellement retouchée!
examples.trans: This image is so heavily retouched!

meanings.note: Sur le chemin du retour = 'on the way back'; être de retour = 'to be back'.

examples.text: Nous serons de retour du marché avant midi.
examples.trans: We will be back from the market before noon.

examples.text: Prenez le parapluie pour le chemin du retour.
examples.trans: Take the umbrella for the walk back.

meanings.en: to go back, to return (conjugated with être)

examples.text: Il est retourné à Paris.
examples.trans: He went back to Paris.

examples.text: Excusez-moi, madame, je retourne à mon bureau avec dignité!
examples.trans: Excuse me, madam, I am going back to my office with dignity!

meanings.note: Retirement from work ('à la retraite' = retired; 'prendre sa retraite' = retire); peaceful haven.

examples.text: Depuis sa retraite, l'ancien professeur peint tous les matins.
examples.trans: Since retiring, the former professor paints every morning.

examples.text: Ce jardin calme est une vraie retraite au cœur de la ville.
examples.trans: This quiet garden is a true retreat in the heart of town.

meanings.note: Fêter nos retrouvailles. Prefix 're-'/'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'reunion, reunion event'.

examples.text: Quel progrès! Aujourd'hui notre cour accueille des retrouvailles: discrétion absolue!
examples.trans: What progress! Today our courtyard hosts a reunion: complete discretion!

examples.text: Je rêve ou quoi?! Tu avais prévu toutes ces retrouvailles, Antoine?
examples.trans: Am I dreaming or what?! Did you plan this whole reunion, Antoine?

examples.text: Ces retrouvailles étaient très émouvantes.
examples.trans: This reunion was very emotional.

retrouver.gloss: to get back, recover, find again

meanings.note: *Retrouver sa voix* means 'to get one's voice back' (both for a person and figuratively for an instrument).

examples.text: Une fois accordé, le vieux piano retrouve toute sa chaleur.
examples.trans: Once tuned, the old piano regains all its warmth.

examples.text: J'ai enfin retrouvé mes lunettes sur l'étagère de l'entrée!
examples.trans: I finally found my glasses again on the hall shelf!

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to upgrade'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'revalorisé').

examples.text: Nous voulons revaloriser vos parts.
examples.trans: We want to increase the value of your shares.

examples.text: Je suis prêt à revaloriser vos parts.
examples.trans: I am ready to increase your shares.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la revanche', plural 'les revanches') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'revenge'.

meanings.en: en revanche = on the other hand, however
meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la revanche', plural 'les revanches') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'en revanche = on the other hand'.

examples.text: En revanche, il nous quitte.
examples.trans: On the other hand, he leaves us.

examples.text: En revanche, François Cluzet nous quitte.
examples.trans: On the other hand, François Cluzet leaves us.

meanings.note: Passé composé with être.

examples.text: Attendez — {F2} apporte le gâteau à leur table en ce moment même.
examples.trans: Wait—{F2} is taking the cake out to their table right now.

examples.text: Reviens vite au bureau, nous avons une réunion urgente!
examples.trans: Come back to the office quickly, we have an urgent meeting!

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le revenu', plural 'les revenus') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'income'.

examples.text: Les séries apportent des revenus.
examples.trans: Series bring revenues.

examples.text: Les séries apportent des revenus réguliers.
examples.trans: Series bring regular income.

meanings.note: Folded-back front edge (lapel) of a jacket or coat, or the reverse side of a page, medal, or hand.
Invariable in the plural: le revers, les revers.

examples.text: Et chaque voisin a accroché sa pince en bouleau numérotée sur le revers de sa veste!
examples.trans: And every neighbour clipped their numbered birch clothespin onto their jacket lapel!

examples.text: Étienne lisse le revers de sa veste avant d'ouvrir le portail.
examples.trans: Etienne smooths the lapel of his jacket before opening the gate.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'reinvigorate'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'revigoré').

examples.text: Vous m'avez revigoré.
examples.trans: You have revitalized me.

examples.text: Grâce à vous! Vous m'avez revigoré.
examples.trans: Thanks to you! You have revitalized me.

revisser.gloss: to screw back on, tighten screws

meanings.note: Formed from *re-* + *visser* (from *la vis*, 'screw').

examples.text: Il revisse le panneau avant du piano avec son tournevis.
examples.trans: He screws the front panel of the piano back on with his screwdriver.

examples.text: Revissez bien la poignée en laiton pour qu'elle ne bouge plus.
examples.trans: Screw the brass handle back on tight so it doesn't wobble.

meanings.note: On se reverra: we'll meet again.
Literally 'until seeing again'.

examples.text: Je peux revoir l'étiquette en papier ici, en plein soleil?
examples.trans: May I look at the paper tag again here, in bright sunlight?

examples.text: Je veux revoir ce film.
examples.trans: I want to see this film again.

meanings.note: Invariable in the plural: les rez-de-chaussée.

examples.text: Pour vous dire la vérité, je déteste le bruit du rez-de-chaussée. J'adore cet endroit!
examples.trans: To tell you the truth, I hate ground-floor noise. I love this space!

examples.text: Aucun immeuble sur cour de plus de quatre-vingts ans ne peut devenir des bureaux privés si le rez-de-chaussée accueille les voisins chaque jour.
examples.trans: No courtyard building over eighty years old may become private offices if the ground floor welcomes neighbours daily.

meanings.en: rich, full-bodied (of food or colour); wealthy
meanings.note: Used warmly in French food talk for full, rounded flavours: un miel doux et riche, un bouillon riche.

examples.text: Ce miel d'automne a un goût doux et très riche.
examples.trans: This autumn honey has a mellow, very rich taste.

examples.text: Le quartier est riche en petites boutiques anciennes.
examples.trans: The neighbourhood is rich in little historic shops.

meanings.note: tirer les rideaux = to draw the curtains

examples.text: Tirez les rideaux.
examples.trans: Draw the curtains.

examples.text: Les rideaux sont fermés.
examples.trans: The curtains are closed.

examples.text: Parfait! Le rideau de fer est ouvert?
examples.trans: Great! Is the metal shutter open?

examples.text: Mais c'est ridicule!
examples.trans: But that's ridiculous!

examples.text: Une histoire ridicule.
examples.trans: A ridiculous story.

meanings.en: to ridicule, make look foolish (se ridiculiser = to make a fool of oneself)
meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'ridicule'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'ridiculisé').

examples.text: Il a peur de se ridiculiser devant toute l'équipe.
examples.trans: He is afraid of making a fool of himself in front of the whole crew.

examples.text: Personne ne veut ridiculiser un grand comédien.
examples.trans: Nobody wants to ridicule a great actor.

examples.text: Je vais me ridiculiser.
examples.trans: I am going to make a fool of myself.

meanings.note: with ne: je ne promets rien; rien n'est signé

examples.text: Je ne promets rien.
examples.trans: I'm not promising anything.

examples.text: Rien n'est signé.
examples.trans: Nothing is signed.

meanings.note: Informal alternative to rire; can also mean joke or be kidding.

examples.text: Nous allons continuer de rigoler.
examples.trans: We're going to keep on laughing.

examples.text: Tu rigoles?
examples.trans: Are you kidding?

meanings.note: Poetic rhyme ('en rimes' = written in rhyming verse).

examples.text: Tous les indices du jeu de piste sont écrits en rimes.
examples.trans: All the clues in the treasure hunt are written in rhyme.

examples.text: Cette jolie rime rend la chanson facile à retenir.
examples.trans: That pretty rhyme makes the song easy to remember.

meanings.note: Riez tant que vous voulez! = Laugh all you want!

examples.text: Tout le monde rit autour de la grande table de cuisine.
examples.trans: Everyone laughs around the big kitchen table.

examples.text: Cette histoire nous a fait rire toute la soirée.
examples.trans: That story made us laugh all evening.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le risotto', plural 'les risottos') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'risotto'.

examples.text: Je te ferai ma recette secrète du risotto.
examples.trans: I will make you my secret risotto recipe.

examples.text: Ce risotto aux champignons est délicieux.
examples.trans: This mushroom risotto is delicious.

meanings.note: Prendre un risque = to take a risk.

examples.text: On ne prend aucun risque.
examples.trans: We're not taking any risks.

examples.text: C'est un grand risque.
examples.trans: It's a big risk.

examples.text: On ne prend aucun risque. Laisse-moi parler.
examples.trans: We're not taking any risks. Let me do the talking.

meanings.note: risquer de + infinitive = to risk / be likely to

examples.text: Ça risque de changer.
examples.trans: It risks changing.

examples.text: Risquer sa vie.
examples.trans: To risk one's life.

examples.text: Ça risque de ressembler à des funérailles!
examples.trans: It is likely to look like a funeral!

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'risky'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: C'est beaucoup trop risqué.
examples.trans: It is much too risky.

examples.text: Évidemment que c'est risqué.
examples.trans: Of course it is risky.

examples.text: Un bébé dans les bureaux, c'est risqué.
examples.trans: A baby in the offices is risky.

meanings.note: plural: des rivaux; feminine: une rivale

examples.text: Tu allais chez nos rivaux.
examples.trans: You were going to our rivals.

examples.text: C'est son grand rival.
examples.trans: He's his big rival.

examples.text: Champagne! Faire croire à tout le monde que tu allais chez nos rivaux pour sauver l'agence!
examples.trans: Champagne! Making everyone believe you were going to our rivals to save the agency!

examples.text: Une rivière coule dans les bois.
examples.trans: A river flows through the woods.

examples.text: La rivière est calme.
examples.trans: The river is calm.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le riz', plural 'les riz') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'rice'.

examples.text: Je prépare du riz.
examples.trans: I am preparing rice.

examples.text: Je prépare du riz en plus.
examples.trans: I am preparing extra rice.

meanings.note: Ne faites pas attention à la robe. Feminine noun ('la robe', plural 'les robes') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'garment'.

examples.text: Elle porte une jolie robe.
examples.trans: She wears a pretty dress.

examples.text: Seulement des robes, des partitions et ma tasse préférée!
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite cup!

meanings.note: Water tap in a sink or shower.

examples.text: En fait, je descendais juste demander pourquoi le robinet de la salle de bain était si frais.
examples.trans: Actually, I only came down to ask why the bathroom tap felt so chilly.

examples.text: Voici le robinet sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the tap, faucet on the table.

meanings.note: un/une romantique; also adjective: un film romantique

examples.text: Les Français sont de vrais romantiques.
examples.trans: The French are true romantics.

examples.text: C'est un grand romantique.
examples.trans: He's a hopeless romantic.

meanings.en: to break up, end a relationship
meanings.note: Rompre avec quelqu'un. Third-group irregular verb inherited from core Latin roots ('-ere'). Core French verb meaning 'to break up, to snap'.

examples.text: Elle a rompu avec Ramzy, c'est tout.
examples.trans: She broke up with Ramzy, that is all.

examples.text: Ils ont rompu hier.
examples.trans: They broke up yesterday.

examples.text: Ils ont rompu leur relation.
examples.trans: They broke up their relationship.

rond.gloss: round; in circles (in tourner en rond)

meanings.en: round, circular; in circles (in tourner en rond)

examples.text: On tourne en rond depuis une heure.
examples.trans: We have been going in circles for an hour.

examples.text: Ils sont assis autour d'une table ronde.
examples.trans: They are sitting around a round table.

ronronner.gloss: to purr, hum smoothly (of a cat, oven, or motor)

meanings.en: to purr (of a cat); to hum contentedly (of a well-tuned oven or appliance)
meanings.note: Onomatopoeic verb from ronron; in everyday French, saying an oven, boiler, or engine ronronne means it is running smoothly and quietly.

examples.text: Le four de la cuisine ronronne doucement pendant la cuisson.
examples.trans: The kitchen oven hums gently away while baking.

examples.text: Le chat du voisin ronronne au soleil sur le banc.
examples.trans: The neighbour's cat purrs in the sunshine on the bench.

meanings.en: room (used in the hotel expression room service)
meanings.note: borrowed from English

examples.text: J'ai commandé le room service.
examples.trans: I ordered room service.

examples.text: Le room service arrive tout de suite.
examples.trans: Room service is arriving right away.

meanings.note: Pink in color; as a feminine noun ('une rose'): garden rose or 'la rose des vents' = compass rose.

examples.text: Le ciel du soir devient tout rose au-dessus des toits.
examples.trans: The evening sky turns all pink above the rooftops.

examples.text: Au coin de la carte brille une belle rose des vents dorée.
examples.trans: In the corner of the map gleams a handsome gilded compass rose.

meanings.note: Wheels of a train, bicycle, or car.

examples.text: Regarde sous les roues: ton prénom et le mien sont toujours écrits au crayon.
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels: your first name and mine are still written in pencil.

examples.text: Voici la roue sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the wheel on the table.

meanings.note: Marqué en rouge = marked in red. Descriptive French adjective meaning 'red'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Les jours sont marqués en rouge.
examples.trans: The days are marked in red.

examples.text: Une voiture rouge.
examples.trans: A red car.

examples.text: Ma valise! J'ouvre la poche du haut... oui, mon ruban rouge!
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, my red ribbon!

rouleau.gloss: roll (of tape, paper, or fabric); rolling pin

meanings.en: roll (of tape, wallpaper, or paper); rolling pin (rouleau à pâtisserie)
meanings.note: Nouns in -eau form their plural with -x: des rouleaux (/ʁulo/).

examples.text: Henri cherche son rouleau de ruban isolant dans la caisse.
examples.trans: Henri looks for his roll of electrical tape in the toolbox.

examples.text: Nadia étale la pâte à tarte avec un rouleau en bois.
examples.trans: Nadia rolls out the pastry dough with a wooden rolling pin.

meanings.en: to drive, travel by vehicle; to roll
meanings.note: Rouler vite = to drive fast. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'drive'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'roulé').

examples.text: Il roulait trop vite.
examples.trans: He was driving too fast.

examples.text: Je pourrais rouler indéfiniment.
examples.trans: I could drive indefinitely.

examples.text: C'est parti, roule vite!
examples.trans: Here we go, drive fast!

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la roulette', plural 'les roulettes') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'roulette'.

examples.text: Jouer à la roulette.
examples.trans: To play roulette.

examples.text: La roulette russe.
examples.trans: Russian roulette.

examples.text: Là-bas, ils jouent à la roulette russe.
examples.trans: Over there, they play Russian roulette.

roulé.gloss: roll, swirl pastry ('roulé à la cannelle')

meanings.en: rolled pastry, cinnamon roll ('roulé à la cannelle')
meanings.note: Noun from the past participle of rouler ('to roll').

examples.text: Les roulés chauds à la cannelle sortent tout juste du four.
examples.trans: The warm cinnamon rolls are coming right out of the oven.

examples.text: Il reste deux roulés dorés sur le grand plateau.
examples.trans: There are two golden rolls left on the big tray.

meanings.note: Outside town.
En route = on the way.

examples.text: La route est longue.
examples.trans: The road is long.

examples.text: Attention à la route!
examples.trans: Watch the road!

meanings.note: installer un routeur = to install a router

examples.text: Le routeur est connecté.
examples.trans: The router is connected.

examples.text: Configurer le routeur.
examples.trans: To configure the router.

examples.text: Isabelle Huppert rêve de jouer un routeur!
examples.trans: Isabelle Huppert dreams of playing a router!

meanings.note: Conjugated exactly like ouvrir (present je rouvre with -er endings, past participle rouvert). Standard French prefers rouvrir over réouvrir.

examples.text: Nous voulons rouvrir le vieux salon de thé vendredi prochain.
examples.trans: We want to reopen the old tearoom next Friday.

examples.text: La boulangerie du coin rouvre mardi matin.
examples.trans: The corner bakery reopens on Tuesday morning.

royal.gloss: royal, of a king or queen

meanings.note: Gelée royale = royal jelly.

examples.text: Prends de la gelée royale.
examples.trans: Take some royal jelly.

examples.text: C'est le palais royal.
examples.trans: It's the royal palace.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le royaume', plural 'les royaumes') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'kingdom'.

examples.text: Le personnage revient du royaume des morts.
examples.trans: The character returns from the realm of the dead.

examples.text: Je reviens du royaume des morts.
examples.trans: I return from the realm of the dead.

meanings.note: Coloured ribbon tied to a handle or parcel.

examples.text: Dites-leur que la mienne a un ruban rouge dans la poche du haut!
examples.trans: Tell them mine has a red ribbon in the top pocket!

examples.text: Ma valise! J'ouvre la poche du haut... oui, mon ruban rouge!
examples.trans: My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, my red ribbon!

examples.text: Complètement par accident! Chez mon cousin, je l'ai ouverte et j'ai vu des partitions et un ruban rouge.
examples.trans: By complete accident! At my cousin's flat, I opened it and saw sheet music and a red ribbon.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'rough'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Ce tournage est particulièrement rude.
examples.trans: This shoot is particularly grueling.

examples.text: Ce tournage est particulièrement rude aujourd'hui.
examples.trans: This shoot is particularly rough today.

examples.text: Les producteurs sont très rudes.
examples.trans: The producers are very tough.

meanings.note: Dans la rue = in the street.

examples.text: Nadia parle à tout le monde dans notre rue comme à de vieux amis.
examples.trans: Nadia talks to everyone on our street like old friends.

examples.text: Parfait. La fenêtre donne sur la rue ou sur la cour?
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: Pas de numéro de téléphone, malheureusement. Seulement deux initiales et un vieux nom de rue.
examples.trans: No phone number, unfortunately. Only two initials and an old street name.

meanings.note: Diminutive of rue ('street').

examples.text: Prenez la deuxième rue, à côté du fleuriste, pas la ruelle étroite.
examples.trans: Take the second street, beside the flower shop, not the narrow alley.

examples.text: Voici la ruelle sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the narrow lane, side alley on the table.

meanings.note: l'agence est ruinée = the agency is ruined

examples.text: Sans elle, notre agence est ruinée.
examples.trans: Without her, our agency is ruined.

examples.text: Ruiner une entreprise.
examples.trans: To ruin a business.

examples.text: Notre agence est complètement ruinée, Andréa.
examples.trans: Our agency is completely ruined, Andréa.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'financially ruined'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: L'agence est ruinée.
examples.trans: The agency is ruined.

examples.text: Votre agence est complètement ruinée!
examples.trans: Your agency is completely ruined!

meanings.note: An unconfirmed story circulating among people.

examples.text: Les rumeurs de Rio.
examples.trans: The rumours from Rio.

examples.text: C'est juste une rumeur.
examples.trans: It's just a rumour.

examples.text: Et les rumeurs de Rio, c'est vrai?
examples.trans: And the rumours from Rio, are they true?

meanings.note: une rupture difficile = a difficult breakup

examples.text: Une rupture pendant la sortie du film.
examples.trans: A breakup during the film release.

examples.text: La rupture du contrat.
examples.trans: The breach of contract.

examples.text: Une rupture pendant la sortie du film, c'est mauvais pour nous.
examples.trans: A breakup during the film release is bad for us.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'Russian'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: La roulette russe.
examples.trans: Russian roulette.

examples.text: La langue russe.
examples.trans: The Russian language.

examples.text: Là-bas, ils jouent à la roulette russe.
examples.trans: Over there, they play Russian roulette.

meanings.note: Notice French spelling: no *h* after *r* (*rythme*, unlike English *rhythm*).

examples.text: Elle tape doucement le rythme de la valse du bout des doigts.
examples.trans: She softly taps the rhythm of the waltz with her fingertips.

examples.text: Chacun travaille à son propre rythme dans l'atelier.
examples.trans: Everyone works at their own pace in the workshop.

meanings.note: Il y a des règles.
Une règle en plastique.

examples.text: Il y a des règles à respecter.
examples.trans: There are rules to follow.

examples.text: Règle numéro un: buvez d'abord du thé chaud, puis répondez à la sonnette.
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then answer the bell.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le règlement', plural 'les règlements') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'rules'.
Masculine noun ('le règlement', plural 'les règlements') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'settlement'.

examples.text: Le règlement de l'immeuble est strict.
examples.trans: The building regulations are strict.

examples.text: Bien vu, Claire. Antoine lit des règlements d'urbanisme chaque semaine.
examples.trans: Good catch, Claire. Antoine reads city building rules every week.

ré.gloss: D (second musical note: do, ré, mi)

meanings.note: French names musical notes with solfège syllables (do, ré, mi, fa, sol, la, si) rather than letters C–B; invariable masculine noun: le ré du milieu = middle D.

examples.text: Sur ce vieux piano, le ré du milieu ne sonne plus.
examples.trans: On this old piano, the middle D no longer sounds.

examples.text: Odette accorde doucement le la et le ré.
examples.trans: Odette gently tunes the A and the D.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la réaction', plural 'les réactions') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'reaction'.

examples.text: C'est une réaction trop impulsive.
examples.trans: That is too impulsive a reaction.

examples.text: C'est une réaction trop impulsive, attends!
examples.trans: That is too impulsive a reaction, wait!

examples.text: Votre réaction est incroyable, Jean!
examples.trans: Your reaction is incredible, Jean!

meanings.note: bien / mal réagir = to react well / badly

examples.text: J'ai mal réagi.
examples.trans: I reacted badly.

examples.text: Elle réagit très vite.
examples.trans: She reacts very quickly.

meanings.note: A film or television director; feminine réalisatrice.

examples.text: Gabor est réalisateur.
examples.trans: Gabor is a director.

examples.text: La réalisatrice arrive.
examples.trans: The director (woman) is arriving.

examples.text: C'est un truc bizarre des réalisateurs.
examples.trans: It's a weird thing directors do.

meanings.note: Derived with the Romance agent/quality suffix '-eur'/'-euse' (from Latin '-or'/'-tor'). Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'director'.

examples.text: La réalisatrice.
examples.trans: The director.

examples.text: La réalisatrice panique sur le tournage.
examples.trans: The director is panicking on the film set.

examples.text: La réalisatrice crie que la prise est coupée!
examples.trans: The director is shouting that the take is cut!

réaliser.gloss: to fulfill, make real; to realize

meanings.en: to fulfill, make real; to realize
meanings.note: To bring a dream, plan, or craft piece to life ('réaliser un rêve'); in modern usage, also to realize.

examples.text: Ouvrir cette librairie, c'était réaliser un rêve de jeunesse.
examples.trans: Opening this bookshop meant fulfilling a childhood dream.

examples.text: L'artisan a réalisé toute la gravure à la main.
examples.trans: The craftsperson executed all the engraving by hand.

meanings.note: Soyons réalistes. Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Soyons réalistes.
examples.trans: Let us be realistic.

examples.text: Une vision réaliste.
examples.trans: A realistic vision.

examples.text: Soyons réalistes et évitons la dispersion.
examples.trans: Let us be realistic and avoid scattering our efforts.

meanings.note: la dure réalité = the harsh reality

examples.text: La réalité dépasse la fiction.
examples.trans: Reality exceeds fiction.

examples.text: Accepter la réalité.
examples.trans: To accept reality.

examples.text: Votre accueil mérite dix sur dix! Mais en réalité, je suis architecte acousticien.
examples.trans: Your welcome deserves ten out of ten! In reality, though, I am an acoustic architect.

examples.text: C'est un geste de rébellion.
examples.trans: It's a gesture of rebellion.

examples.text: Un esprit de rébellion.
examples.trans: A spirit of rebellion.

examples.text: Dans le film, c'est un geste de rébellion.
examples.trans: In the film, it's a gesture of rebellion.

examples.text: J'ai eu deux enfants récemment.
examples.trans: I had two children recently.

examples.text: Elle est arrivée récemment.
examples.trans: She arrived recently.

examples.text: Quoi? Mais il sait que j'ai eu deux enfants récemment?
examples.trans: What? But does he know I had two children recently?

meanings.note: c'est tout récent = it's very recent

examples.text: C'est une histoire récente.
examples.trans: It's a recent story.

examples.text: Un événement tout récent.
examples.trans: A very recent event.

examples.text: Oui, c'est tout récent.
examples.trans: Yes, it is very recent.

meanings.en: front desk, reception area of hotel or office
meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la réception', plural 'les réceptions') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'front desk'.

examples.text: Je descends à la réception.
examples.trans: I am going down to reception.

examples.text: Pas touche, Nadia! Claire, voulez-vous rester comme responsable de la réception pour de bon?
examples.trans: Hands off, Nadia! Claire, would you stay as permanent front-desk manager?

meanings.note: same form for a man or a woman: un / une réceptionniste

examples.text: Oh, ça s'ouvre! Merci. Je suis Claire, la nouvelle réceptionniste.
examples.trans: Oh, it opens! Thank you. I am Claire, the new receptionist.

examples.text: Je ne suis pas vraiment réceptionniste.
examples.trans: I'm not really a receptionist.

meanings.note: Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin '-are') meaning 'to claim'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'réclamé').

examples.text: Ils réclament deux millions.
examples.trans: They are claiming two million.

examples.text: Que réclament ces producteurs exactement?
examples.trans: What do these producers claim exactly?

examples.text: Ils réclament deux millions de dollars!
examples.trans: They are claiming two million dollars!

meanings.note: Récompenser la loyauté.

examples.text: Il récompensera ma loyauté.
examples.trans: He will reward my loyalty.

examples.text: Le patron récompense ses employés.
examples.trans: The boss rewards his employees.

examples.text: Donc il récompensera ma loyauté. Fais le guet, d'accord?
examples.trans: So he will reward my loyalty. Keep watch, okay?

meanings.note: se réconcilier avec qqn = to make up with someone

examples.text: Une fois réconciliés, j'aurai les deux.
examples.trans: Once reconciled, I will have both.

examples.text: Ils se sont réconciliés.
examples.trans: They made up.

examples.text: Une fois réconciliés, j'aurai les deux à nouveau.
examples.trans: Once reconciled, I will have both again.

meanings.note: Avoir besoin de réconfort. Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard masculine noun meaning 'comfort, reassurance'.

examples.text: J'ai besoin de réconfort aujourd'hui.
examples.trans: I need comforting today.

examples.text: Ses paroles m'ont apporté du réconfort.
examples.trans: Her words brought me comfort.

meanings.note: A lost thing, or a lost client.

examples.text: Je veux récupérer mon sac.
examples.trans: I want to get my bag back.

examples.text: Il récupère les enfants à cinq heures.
examples.trans: He picks up the children at five.

meanings.en: to draft, to write (an essay, report, or contract)
meanings.note: Rédiger un rapport.

examples.text: J'ai un rapport à rédiger.
examples.trans: I have a report to write.

examples.text: Elle rédige le contrat.
examples.trans: She is drafting the contract.

examples.text: J'ai encore une grosse partie de mon rapport à rédiger.
examples.trans: I still have a big part of my report to write.

meanings.note: Offrir une réduction = to offer a discount.

examples.text: Attendez: quelle réduction est-ce qu'on lui offre pour le changement de chambre?
examples.trans: Wait: what discount do we offer him for the room change?

examples.text: Voici la réduction sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the discount, price reduction on the table.

meanings.note: réduire les dépenses = to cut expenses

examples.text: Réduire les salaires pendant deux mois.
examples.trans: To reduce salaries for two months.

examples.text: Ils réduisent le budget.
examples.trans: They are reducing the budget.

examples.text: Notre seule option est de réduire les salaires pendant deux mois.
examples.trans: Our only option is to reduce salaries for two months.

meanings.note: French relational/descriptive adjective derived from Latin adjectival roots.

examples.text: Cet animal est bien réel.
examples.trans: This animal is indeed real.

examples.text: Le monde réel.
examples.trans: The real world.

examples.text: Attends, cet animal sauvage est bien réel?
examples.trans: Wait, is this wild animal truly real?

meanings.en: to try again, to have another go
meanings.note: Re- + essayer.

examples.text: Tu peux réessayer?
examples.trans: Can you try again?

examples.text: Je vais réessayer demain.
examples.trans: I'll try again tomorrow.

meanings.en: to think, to think something over

examples.text: Il a réfléchi.
examples.trans: He has thought it over.

examples.text: Je réfléchis.
examples.trans: I'm thinking.

meanings.note: Used with a reflexive pronoun: se réfugier.

examples.text: Il se réfugie chez un ami.
examples.trans: He takes refuge at a friend’s home.

examples.text: Elle s'est réfugiée dans sa chambre.
examples.trans: She took refuge in her room.

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le régime', plural 'les régimes') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'diet'.

examples.text: Suivre un régime.
examples.trans: To follow a diet.

examples.text: Un régime strict.
examples.trans: A strict diet.

examples.text: Ils t'ont contaminée avec ce régime!
examples.trans: They contaminated you with this diet!

meanings.note: De la région on menus and market stalls means 'locally produced / from the local area' (du miel de la région).

examples.text: Nous servons uniquement des fromages et du miel de la région.
examples.trans: We serve only cheeses and honey from the local region.

examples.text: Cette région est connue pour ses vergers et ses marchés.
examples.trans: This region is famous for its orchards and markets.

examples.text: Règle ça, s'il te plaît.
examples.trans: Sort it out, please.

examples.text: Je vais régler le problème.
examples.trans: I'll sort out the problem.

meanings.note: Describes smooth, even brushstrokes (*des coups réguliers*), steady breathing, or regular intervals.

examples.text: Étalez la peinture en gestes lents et réguliers.
examples.trans: Spread the paint in slow, even strokes.

examples.text: La pluie tombe d'un bruit doux et régulier sur la verrière.
examples.trans: The rain falls with a soft, steady sound on the glass roof.

meanings.note: Feminine action/state noun from Latin '-tio'/'-sio'. Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard feminine noun meaning 'renovation, repairs'.

examples.text: J'ai financé les rénovations.
examples.trans: I funded the renovations.

examples.text: Une grande rénovation.
examples.trans: A major renovation.

examples.text: J'ai financé les rénovations il y a cinq ans.
examples.trans: I financed the renovations five years ago.

meanings.note: Prefix *ré-* + *ouverture* ('reopening' of a café, theater, or restored room).

examples.text: Nous préparons des tartes fraîches pour la réouverture du salon.
examples.trans: We are baking fresh tarts for the parlor's reopening.

examples.text: Les voisins attendent avec impatience la réouverture du jardin.
examples.trans: The neighbors are eagerly awaiting the garden's reopening.

meanings.note: Feminine noun from réparer ('to fix, repair'); en réparation means 'being repaired'.

examples.text: La réparation de la vieille lampe a pris toute la matinée.
examples.trans: Repairing the old lamp took the whole morning.

examples.text: Après une petite réparation, l'horloge sonne de nouveau.
examples.trans: After a small repair, the clock chimes again.

meanings.en: to repair, to fix, to mend

examples.text: J'ai réparé son chemisier préféré.
examples.trans: I fixed her favourite blouse.

examples.text: Il répare sa voiture.
examples.trans: He's fixing his car.

meanings.note: répartir les tâches = to divide up tasks

examples.text: Nous devons répartir les écoles.
examples.trans: We must divide up the schools.

examples.text: Répartir le travail équitablement.
examples.trans: To distribute work fairly.

examples.text: Nous devons nous répartir toutes les écoles.
examples.trans: We must divide up all the schools.

meanings.note: un réplicant dans le film = a replicant in the movie

examples.text: C'est un réplicant.
examples.trans: He is a replicant.

examples.text: La traque des réplicants.
examples.trans: The hunt for replicants.

examples.text: Quand on découvre que c'est un réplicant.
examples.trans: When you find out that he is a replicant.

meanings.en: line (in a play or film), cue
meanings.note: donner la réplique = to feed lines / act opposite someone
avoir le sens de la réplique = to be quick with a comeback

examples.text: J'ai deux répliques dans cette scène.
examples.trans: I have two lines in this scene.

examples.text: Dis-moi tes répliques.
examples.trans: Say your lines to me.

related.gloss: to feed lines / act opposite someone

meanings.note: Répondre à quelqu'un.

examples.text: Ne réponds pas!
examples.trans: Don't answer!

examples.text: Je dois répondre au téléphone.
examples.trans: I have to answer the phone.

meanings.note: Spoken or written reply to a question, letter, or riddle.

examples.text: La réponse à l'énigme se trouve juste devant nos yeux!
examples.trans: The answer to the riddle is right in front of our eyes!

examples.text: Elle attend une réponse par le courrier de demain.
examples.trans: She is waiting for a reply in tomorrow's mail.

related.gloss: question; matter (pas question = out of the question)

meanings.note: La réputation de l'agence.

examples.text: L'agence a une réputation.
examples.trans: The agency has a reputation.

examples.text: Il y a des règles! L'agence a une réputation! Moi aussi!
examples.trans: There are rules! The agency has a reputation! So do I!

examples.text: J'ai une réputation un peu difficile.
examples.trans: I have a somewhat difficult reputation.

meanings.en: to rehearse, to practise (a role, a play)

examples.text: Je répète un rôle.
examples.trans: I'm rehearsing a part.

examples.text: Pouvez-vous répéter, s'il vous plaît?
examples.trans: Can you repeat, please?

examples.text: Vingt millimètres, en laiton, vanne de chaudière: je vais répéter ça tout le long!
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, boiler valve: I am going to repeat that all the way!

examples.text: J'avais une répétition ce soir.
examples.trans: I had a rehearsal tonight.

examples.text: La répétition commence à deux heures.
examples.trans: Rehearsal starts at two o'clock.

meanings.note: Avoir du réseau / pas de réseau.
Les réseaux sociaux = social media.

examples.text: Il n'y a pas de réseau.
examples.trans: There's no signal.

examples.text: Tu as du réseau ici?
examples.trans: Do you have signal here?

meanings.note: Avoir une réservation au nom de... = to have a booking under...

examples.text: Je dois lire le cahier de réservations, mais je ne trouve pas mes lunettes!
examples.trans: I need to read the reservation book, but I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: Bonjour, ma chère. J'ai une réservation pour {F3}.
examples.trans: Good morning, my dear. I have a booking for {F3}.

examples.text: Qui est-ce? Une autre réservation pour ce week-end?
examples.trans: Who is it? Another booking for this weekend?

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la réserve', plural 'les réserves') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'reserve'.

examples.text: Nous utilisons les fonds de réserve.
examples.trans: We use the reserve funds.

examples.text: Et j'ai deux oreillers doux et un tapis bleu tissé dans la réserve!
examples.trans: And I have two soft pillows and a woven blue rug in the storeroom!

meanings.note: A table, a room, a massage.

examples.text: Réservez-moi un massage.
examples.trans: Book me a massage.

examples.text: J'ai réservé une table.
examples.trans: I've booked a table.

meanings.note: Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Une action résolue.
examples.trans: A resolute action.

examples.text: Une action résolue amène le changement.
examples.trans: Resolute action brings about change.

meanings.note: For bells, footsteps, or music to ring out and echo (do not confuse with 'raisonner' = to reason).

examples.text: Les douze coups de midi résonnent sur toute la place.
examples.trans: The twelve strokes of noon ring out across the whole square.

examples.text: Nos pas résonnent doucement sous le porche en pierre.
examples.trans: Our footsteps echo softly under the stone archway.

meanings.note: Irregular third-group French verb inherited from core Latin roots, used across registers for 'to resolve'.

examples.text: Il faut résoudre ce problème.
examples.trans: We must resolve this problem.

examples.text: Mathias compte résoudre cette crise seul.
examples.trans: Mathias intends to resolve this crisis alone.

meanings.en: les résultats médicaux = medical test results

examples.text: Ce sont vos résultats médicaux.
examples.trans: It's your medical results.

examples.text: C'est un bon résultat.
examples.trans: It's a good result.

meanings.note: Voilà le résumé. Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity. Standard masculine noun meaning 'summary, synopsis'.

examples.text: Voilà le résumé de la scène.
examples.trans: Here is the summary of the scene.

examples.text: Fais-moi un résumé du livre.
examples.trans: Give me a summary of the book.

examples.text: Des simples résumés pour votre assistante?
examples.trans: Simple summaries for your assistant?

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le rétablissement', plural 'les rétablissements') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'recovery'.

examples.text: Bon rétablissement.
examples.trans: Get well soon.

examples.text: Je vous souhaite un prompt rétablissement.
examples.trans: I wish you a speedy recovery.

examples.text: Regarde cette carte de bon rétablissement.
examples.trans: Look at this get-well card.

meanings.note: être en réunion = to be in a meeting

examples.text: J'ai une réunion.
examples.trans: I've got a meeting.

examples.text: La réunion est à midi.
examples.trans: The meeting is at noon.

meanings.note: To gather people or scattered pieces back together ('se réunir' = meet, gather).

examples.text: Réunissez les quatre cartes bord à bord sur la table.
examples.trans: Bring the four cards together edge to edge on the table.

examples.text: La fête du tilleul réunit tout le quartier chaque été.
examples.trans: The linden festival brings the whole neighborhood together every summer.

meanings.note: réussir à faire qc = to succeed in doing sth

examples.text: Elle veut réussir au cinéma.
examples.trans: She wants to succeed in cinema.

examples.text: Elle est mignonne et elle couche pour réussir.
examples.trans: She is cute and sleeps her way to success.

examples.text: Je ne couche pas pour réussir.
examples.trans: I do not sleep around to succeed.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la réussite', plural 'les réussites') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'success'.

examples.text: Cette soirée est une vraie réussite.
examples.trans: This evening is a real success.

examples.text: Je félicite toute l'équipe pour sa réussite.
examples.trans: I congratulate the whole team on its success.

examples.text: La réussite chez ASK est toujours collective.
examples.trans: Success at ASK is always collective.

meanings.note: Régler son réveil = to set one's alarm.

examples.text: Réglez votre réveil, Henri. Demain matin, on gagne contre l'eau froide!
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Henri. Tomorrow morning, we beat the cold water!

examples.text: Voici le réveil sur la table.
examples.trans: Here is the alarm clock on the table.

meanings.note: Se réveiller means to wake up oneself.

examples.text: Elle réveille son ami.
examples.trans: She wakes her friend.

examples.text: La chambre quatre se réveille à sept heures et quart!
examples.trans: Room four wakes up at quarter past seven!

meanings.note: Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Elle est enfin réveillée.
examples.trans: She is finally awake.

examples.text: Ah, la dormeuse est enfin réveillée!
examples.trans: Ah, the sleepyhead is finally awake!

examples.text: Te voilà enfin réveillée si tôt.
examples.trans: There you are finally awake so early.

meanings.note: Classic cast-iron streetlamp lighting sidewalks and squares.

examples.text: Les réverbères en fonte s'allument un à un à la tombée du soir.
examples.trans: The cast-iron streetlamps light up one by one at dusk.

examples.text: La pluie fine brille dans le halo du réverbère.
examples.trans: The fine rain glints in the halo of the streetlamp.

meanings.note: Review material already learned.

meanings.en: to review or revise (a text, a decision)
meanings.note: Look at it again and make changes if needed.

examples.text: Il révise ce soir.
examples.trans: He is studying tonight.

examples.text: Je révise mes cours.
examples.trans: I am reviewing my lessons.

meanings.note: Adjective of capability/quality formed with '-able'/'-ible' (from Latin '-abilis'/'-ibilis'). Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Une décision judiciaire révocable.
examples.trans: A revocable judicial decision.

examples.text: Mais ce sera révocable avec ton consentement!
examples.trans: But that would be revocable with your consent!

meanings.note: Prefix 'ré-' marks repetition, return, or intensity.

examples.text: Ce mensonge est tout simplement révoltant!
examples.trans: This lie is quite simply revolting!

examples.text: C'est révoltant de traiter ses collègues comme ça.
examples.trans: It is disgusting to treat one's colleagues like that.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la révolution', plural 'les révolutions') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'revolution'.

examples.text: La Révolution française.
examples.trans: The French Revolution.

examples.text: Un film sur la Révolution française.
examples.trans: A movie about the French Revolution.

meanings.note: révélation féminine = best female newcomer

examples.text: On annonce la révélation féminine.
examples.trans: They are announcing the female newcomer.

examples.text: On annonce la révélation féminine maintenant.
examples.trans: They are announcing female newcomer now.

meanings.note: Révéler un secret. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to reveal'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'révélé').

examples.text: Sans révéler qui était son père.
examples.trans: Without revealing who her father was.

examples.text: Révéler la vérité.
examples.trans: To reveal the truth.

examples.text: Elle s'y est fait une place sans révéler qui était son père.
examples.trans: She made a place for herself there without revealing who her father was.

meanings.en: to rewrite, to write again (conjugated like 'écrire')
meanings.note: Réécrire le planning.

examples.text: J'ai dû réécrire le planning.
examples.trans: I had to rewrite the schedule.

examples.text: Il faut réécrire cette scène.
examples.trans: We have to rewrite this scene.

meanings.note: une réécriture complète = a complete rewrite

examples.text: Le scénario a besoin d'une réécriture.
examples.trans: The script needs a rewrite.

examples.text: Proposer une réécriture.
examples.trans: To suggest a rewrite.

examples.text: Je dirai que tu exiges une réécriture.
examples.trans: I will say that you demand a rewrite.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la rééducation', plural 'les rééducations') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'physical rehabilitation'.

examples.text: Il va l'aider pour sa rééducation.
examples.trans: He will help her with her rehabilitation.

examples.text: Faire des séances de rééducation.
examples.trans: To do rehabilitation sessions.

examples.text: Il va beaucoup l'aider pour sa rééducation.
examples.trans: He will help her a lot with her rehabilitation.

examples.text: C'est comme un rêve.
examples.trans: It's like a dream.

examples.text: C'est mon rêve.
examples.trans: It's my dream.

meanings.note: Rêver de = to dream of.

meanings.en: je rêve! = I must be dreaming! / I can't believe this!
meanings.note: Spoken exclamation.

examples.text: Elle rêve de cinéma.
examples.trans: She dreams of the cinema.

examples.text: Je rêve ou quoi?! Tu avais prévu toutes ces retrouvailles, Antoine?
examples.trans: Am I dreaming or what?! Did you plan this whole reunion, Antoine?

examples.text: Je rêve ou quoi?!
examples.trans: Am I dreaming or what?!

meanings.en: part, role (in a film or play)
meanings.note: Un rôle dans un film.

examples.text: Il a un nouveau rôle.
examples.trans: He has a new part.

examples.text: C'est quoi le rôle?
examples.trans: What's the part?

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le rôti', plural 'les rôtis') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'roast'.

examples.text: Le rôti cuit au four.
examples.trans: The roast is cooking in the oven.

examples.text: Mon beau rôti est foutu!
examples.trans: My fine roast is ruined!

meanings.note: Past participle *rôti(e)* is very common on French menus (*des tomates rôties au four*, *légumes rôtis*).

examples.text: Faites rôtir les tomates au four avec du thym et de l'huile d'olive.
examples.trans: Roast the tomatoes in the oven with thyme and olive oil.

examples.text: Les légumes rôtis donnent un goût riche à la soupe.
examples.trans: Roasted vegetables give the soup a rich flavor.

meanings.note: S'accrocher à quelque chose.
Figurative: accroche-toi!.

examples.text: Accroche-toi!
examples.trans: Hold on!

examples.text: Elle s'accroche au cheval.
examples.trans: She's holding on to the horse.

s'agir.gloss: to be a matter of, be about

meanings.en: to be about, to be a matter of
meanings.note: Il s'agit de = it is about. French '-ir' verb (from Latin '-ire'). Core French verb meaning 'to be a matter of, be about'.

examples.text: Ici, il s'agit de vrais artistes.
examples.trans: Here, it is about real artists.

examples.text: De quoi s'agit-il?
examples.trans: What is it about?

meanings.en: to flatten oneself, bow down, grovel
meanings.note: s'aplatir devant quelqu'un = to grovel before someone

examples.text: Je ne vais pas m'aplatir devant lui.
examples.trans: I will not bow down before him.

examples.text: Il s'aplatit toujours.
examples.trans: He always grovels.

examples.text: Je ne vais pas m'aplatir.
examples.trans: I will not bow down.

meanings.note: ça s'appelle = it's called; je m'appelle = my name is

examples.text: Ça s'appelle Absence.
examples.trans: It's called Absence.

examples.text: Je m'appelle Sofia.
examples.trans: My name is Sofia.

meanings.note: Reflexive.

meanings.en: s'arrêter de + infinitive: to stop doing

examples.text: Le bus s'arrête ici.
examples.trans: The bus stops here.

examples.text: Je ne peux plus m'arrêter.
examples.trans: I can't stop anymore.

meanings.note: Reflexive verb.
Polite imperative.

examples.text: Asseyez-vous, s'il vous plaît.
examples.trans: Have a seat, please.

examples.text: Assieds-toi là.
examples.trans: Sit there.

meanings.note: s'attendre à + noun or infinitive: je ne m'attendais pas à te voir

examples.text: Je ne m'attendais pas à ça.
examples.trans: I wasn't expecting that.

examples.text: Il s'attend à un problème.
examples.trans: He's expecting a problem.

s'effondrer.governs: reflexive (passé composé with être: je me suis effondré(e))

meanings.note: For collapsing physically or falling apart emotionally; pronominal verb with être in compound past tenses.

examples.text: Sans Samuel, vous vous effondrez!
examples.trans: Without Samuel, you're falling apart!

examples.text: Le pont s'effondre.
examples.trans: The bridge collapses.

examples.text: Hippolyte m'a dit que tu t'effondrais.
examples.trans: Hippolyte told me you were collapsing.

meanings.en: to get carried away, to get worked up
meanings.note: Get carried away or overexcited; uses être in compound past tenses.

examples.text: Je me suis emballée.
examples.trans: I got carried away.

examples.text: Ne t'emballe pas!
examples.trans: Don't get carried away!

examples.text: Je suis désolée. Je me suis emballée.
examples.trans: I'm sorry. I got carried away.

meanings.note: Kiss each other; the reciprocal object se appears before the verb. Compound past uses être: ils se sont embrassés.
Embrace or hug each other.

examples.text: Ils s'embrassent.
examples.trans: They're kissing.

examples.text: On s'embrasse pour dire bonjour.
examples.trans: We kiss to say hello.

examples.text: Ils s'embrassent vraiment.
examples.trans: They really kiss.

meanings.note: Compare dormir ('to be asleep') vs s'endormir ('to fall asleep').

cells: il s'est endormi / elle s'est endormie
ils se sont endormis / elles se sont endormies
